muyesser-irab:180-180.t:
﴿ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها﴾: the و is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ولله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); الأسماء is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); الحسنى is a naʿt (adjective); in فادعوه the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and ادعوه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ادعوه.
﴿وذروا الذين يلحدون في أسمائه﴾: the و is a conjunction; ذروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; الذين is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause يلحدون is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; في أسمائه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿سيجزون ما كانوا يعملون﴾: سيجزون is an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ما is the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause كانوا يعملون is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position; and the clause يعملون is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:181-181.t: ﴿وممن خلقنا أمة يهدون بالحق وبه يعدلون﴾: the و is a conjunction; ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause خلقنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; أمة is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يهدون بالحق is a naʿt (adjective) of أمة; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعدلون.

muyesser-irab:182-182.t: ﴿والذين كذبوا بآياتنا سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون﴾: the و is a conjunction, or resumptive; الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا; and the clause سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون is the khabar (predicate). Or: الذين is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb on the basis of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), the implied form being: سنستدرج الذين كذبوا. من حيث is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نستدرجهم; the clause لا يعلمون is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿والذين كذبوا...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:183-183.t:
﴿وأملي لهم﴾: the و is a conjunction, and أملي is conjoined to نستدرجهم, by way of a kind of iltifāt (shift of person); or the و is resumptive, on the view that it is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: وأنا أملي لهم; the clause ﴿أملي لهم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أملي.
﴿إن كيدي متين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); كيدي is its noun and متين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:184-184.t:
﴿أولم يتفكروا ما بصاحبهم من جنة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); the و is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; يتفكروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; ما is negative; بصاحبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila) particle; and جنة is genitive in form, nominative in position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause is in the position of an accusative as governed by يتفكروا, which operates on it, because of the presence of the suspending element (al-muʿalliq), namely the negative ﴿ما﴾. Or ﴿ما﴾ is interrogative, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ, the khabar being بصاحبهم, and من جنة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن هو إلا نذير مبين﴾: إن is negative; هو is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); نذير is the khabar; and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:185-185.t:
﴿أولم ينظروا في ملكوت السماوات والأرض وما خلق الله من شيء﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; the و is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; ينظروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); في ملكوت السماوات والأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينظر; ما is conjoined to ملكوت; the clause خلق is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; من شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأن عسى أن يكون قد اقترب أجلهم﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause is in the position of a genitive by conjunction to ﴿ما﴾ before it, i.e.: "and in [the fact] that". أن is lightened from the heavy (anna); its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause عسى; the noun of عسى is latent (mustatir), and أن together with what falls in its scope is its khabar; the noun of يكون is likewise the pronoun of the matter, and the clause قد اقترب أجلهم is its khabar.
﴿فبأي حديث بعده يؤمنون﴾: the ف is resumptive; بأي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنون; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:186-186.t:
﴿من يضلل الله فلا هادي له﴾: من is a jussive conditional noun, in the position of an accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يضلل; الله is the fāʿil (agent); the ف is the linking fāʾ; لا is the lā of generic negation; هادي is its noun; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿ويذرهم﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause ﴿يذرهم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the ه is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿في طغيانهم يعمهون﴾: في طغيانهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعمهون; and the clause يعمهون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the ه.

muyesser-irab:187-187.t:
﴿يسئلونك عن الساعة أيان مرساها﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. يسألونك is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عن الساعة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك; أيان is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverbial of time, and it is attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مرساها is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is a badal (substitute) for الساعة.
﴿قل إنما علمها عند ربي لا يجليها لوقتها إلا هو﴾: إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; علمها is the mubtadaʾ; the adverb is attached to an omitted khabar; the clause لا يجليها is a ḥāl (circumstantial); لوقتها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجليها; the clause إنما with what falls in its scope is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and هو is the fāʿil of يجليها, or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil.
﴿ثقلت في السماوات والأرض﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ثقلت.
﴿لا تأتيكم إلا بغتة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا تأتيكم is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction; بغتة is a ḥāl, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), by having تأتيكم take on the meaning of تبغتكم.
﴿يسئلونك كأنك حفي عنها﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يسألونك is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause كأنك is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); كأن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ك is its noun, and حفي is its khabar; عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حفي.
﴿قل إنما علمها عند الله﴾: قل is an imperative verb; إنما is the restraining and restrained particle; علمها is the mubtadaʾ; and عند الله is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the و is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) and of the accusative; أكثر الناس is its noun; and the clause لا يعلمون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:188-188.t:
﴿قل لا أملك لنفسي نفعا ولا ضرا إلا ما شاء الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause لا أملك is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); لا is negative; أملك is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); نفعًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لنفسي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أملك, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿نفعًا﴾, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of it had it come after it; إلا is a particle of exception; and ما is excepted from ﴿نفعًا وضرًّا﴾, or a badal (substitute) for them.
﴿ولو كنت أعلم الغيب لاستكثرت من الخير﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; كنت is a defective, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the ت is its noun, and the clause أعلم is its khabar (predicate); الغيب is the mafʿūl bihi; in لاستكثرت the ل is the lām occurring in the apodosis of لو, and استكثرت is a verb and its fāʿil; من الخير is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استكثرت; and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما مسني السوء﴾: the و is a conjunction; the clause ما مسني السوء is conjoined to استكثرت; ما is negative.
﴿إن أنا إلا نذير وبشير لقوم يؤمنون﴾: إن is negative; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); نذير is the khabar; بشير is conjoined to نذير; لقوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير and بشير; and the clause يؤمنون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:189-189.t:
﴿هو الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position, and it is an address to the people of Mecca. هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause خلقكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; من نفس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقكم; and واحدة is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وجعل منها زوجها ليسكن إليها﴾: جعل, in the sense of خلق (created), is conjoined to خلقكم, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعل; زوجها is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يسكن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its fāʿil is "he"; إليها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسكن. What is meant by "the soul" (النفس) is Adam, and the feminine gender of the pronoun is with regard to the word النفس.
﴿فلما تغشاها حملت حملا خفيفا فمرت به﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لما is linking, or temporal (ḥīniyya); the clause حملت has no grammatical position; حملًا, if it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and if it is in the sense of "the foetus", it is a mafʿūl bihi; خفيفًا is a naʿt, brought to convey that she was not harmed by it, as pregnant women usually suffer the pains of pregnancy, or as an indication of its beginning and its being a drop (nuṭfa) that does not weigh down the belly. The ف is a conjunction; مرت is conjoined to حملت; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مرت, i.e.: she went to and fro in accomplishing her tasks and carrying them out without hardship or difficulty.
﴿فلما أثقلت دعوا الله ربهما﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لما is linking, or temporal; دعوا الله is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and ربهما is a badal (substitute).
﴿لئن آتيتنا صالحا لنكونن من الشاكرين﴾: the ل is the lām that prepares for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); the oath clause is resumptive, to indicate the oath clause, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; آتيتنا is a verb and its fāʿil, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); نا is the mafʿūl bihi; صالحًا is a naʿt of an omitted object, standing in its place, i.e.: a righteous child (ولدًا صالحًا); the ل is the lām occurring in the answer to the oath because the oath comes first; نكونن is a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); من الشاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar. The clause ﴿لئن آتيتنا﴾ is explicative of the clause دعوا الله, with no grammatical position; or the clause is the object of an omitted saying, its implied form being: فقالا: لئن آتيتنا (so they both said: if You give us). The clause لنكونن is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, as established.

muyesser-irab:190-190.t:
﴿فلما آتاهما صالحا جعلا له شركاء فيما آتاهما﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لما is an adverb in the sense of حين (when), containing the meaning of condition; آتاهما is a verb and its object; صالحًا is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جعلا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل; شركاء is the object of جعلا; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شركاء; and the clause آتاهما is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فتعالى الله عما يشركون﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿تعالى الله﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; عما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تعالى﴾; and the clause يشركون: it has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative.

muyesser-irab:191-191.t: ﴿أيشركون ما لا يخلق شيئا وهم يخلقون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); يشركون is an imperfect verb, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause لا يخلق is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يخلقون, in the passive form, is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:192-192.t: ﴿ولا يستطيعون لهم نصرا ولا أنفسهم ينصرون﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يستطيعون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نصرا﴾; ﴿نصرا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لا﴾ is likewise a conjunction; ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ينصرون﴾; and ﴿ينصرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the و is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:193-193.t:
﴿وإن تدعوهم إلى الهدى لا يتبعوكم﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تدعوهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the و is the fāʿil (agent), and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), referring to the idols; إلى الهدى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تدعوهم; لا is negative; and يتبعوكم is the jussive (majzūm) apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿سواء عليكم أدعوتموهم أم أنتم صامتون﴾: سواء is a fronted khabar (predicate); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سواء; the hamza is for the interrogative, and it is the hamza of equalisation (taswiya), which together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar; it and what falls in its scope are an interpreted maṣdar, the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). Or ﴿سواء﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil of ﴿سواء﴾, which is treated like a maṣdar. ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction and is called "connected" (muttaṣila); أنتم is the mubtadaʾ, and صامتون is the khabar; and the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿إنكم لتأتون الرجال شهوة من دون النساء﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the كاف is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause تأتون is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. الرجال is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and شهوة is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. you have no motive except bare lust; or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the sense of «مشتهين» (lusting), i.e. following the calls and incitements of lust, heedless of its ugliness. من دون النساء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the واو in ﴿تأتون﴾, i.e. passing over the women; or it is a ḥāl of الرجال.
﴿بل أنتم قوم مسرفون﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb), turning from the rebuke to informing about them with the state that entails the joining of scandals and vices. أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), قوم the khabar, and مسرفون an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿وما كان جواب قومه إلا أن قالوا﴾: The واو is a conjunction, ما is negating, كان is an incomplete past verb, and جواب is its fronted khabar (predicate); قومه is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). إلا is a particle of restriction, and the maṣdarī أن together with what falls within its scope is, as an interpreted maṣdar, the postponed noun of كان, i.e. «except their saying».
﴿أخرجوهم من قريتكم إنهم أناس يتطهرون﴾: The clause is in the accusative position as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl). أخرجوهم is an imperative verb, its agent (fāʿil) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من قريتكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجوهم. إنّ is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and أناس is its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause يتطهرون is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿أناس﴾.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فأنجيناه وأهله إلا امرأته كانت من الغابرين﴾: The فاء is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted that is understood from the context, i.e. «so the punishment befell them, and We saved him». أنجيناه is a verb, its agent (fāʿil) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أهله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the هاء, or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). إلا is a particle of exception, and امرأته is the excepted (mustathnā), in the accusative; the هاء is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). كانت is an incomplete past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي», and من الغابرين is in the accusative position as its khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿كانت من الغابرين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا﴾: The واو is a conjunction, أمطر is a past verb, and نا is an attached pronoun in the nominative position as its fāʿil (agent). عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمطرنا, and مطرًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because what is meant by it is the stones, and rain is not meant by it at all.
﴿فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المجرمين﴾: The فاء is resumptive, انظر is an imperative verb, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the accusative position as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; عاقبة is its noun, and المجرمين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿فانظر كيف كان...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿وإلى مدين أخاهم شعيبا﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and إلى مدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb that is conjoined to أرسلنا. أخاهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرسلنا, and شعيبا is a badal (substitute) of full correspondence from ﴿أخاهم﴾.
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله﴾: قال is a past verb, يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which has been omitted, as the kasra indicates. The vocative clause and the imperative are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ما is negating, and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). من is a preposition that is redundant (ṣila), and إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) by position, and غيره is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position.
﴿قد جاءتكم بينة من ربكم﴾: The clause falls within the scope of the saying and is in the accusative by it. بينة is the fāʿil (agent) of جاءتكم, and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of بينة.
﴿فأوفوا الكيل والميزان﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, أوفوا is an imperative verb, the واو is the agent, الكيل is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الميزان is conjoined to الكيل.
﴿ولا تبخسوا الناس أشياءهم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, لا is the prohibitive lā, and تبخسوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the واو is its agent, الناس is a direct object, and أشياءهم is a second direct object.
﴿ولا تفسدوا في الأرض بعد إصلاحها﴾: Conjoined to what came before. لا is prohibitive, and تفسدوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تفسدوا, and بعد إصلاحها is an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). A muḍāf must be supplied, i.e. «the reform of its people».
﴿ذلكم خير لكم إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ, and خير is the khabar; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير. إن is conditional, كنتم is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the تاء is its noun, and the verb is in the jussive position as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); مؤمنين is the khabar of كنتم. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted, i.e. «then hasten to faith».

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿ولا تقعدوا بكل صراط توعدون﴾: Also conjoined. بكل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقعدوا, and صراط is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause توعدون is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «and do not sit threatening».
﴿وتصدون عن سبيل الله من آمن به﴾: Also conjoined. عن سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تصدون, and من is the object of تصدون; the clause آمن به is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position, and به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمن.
﴿وتبغونها عوجا﴾: تبغونها is a verb, its agent (fāʿil) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and عوجًا is a ḥāl in which the maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in the place of the derived noun, i.e. «crooked». Or: the ها is in the accusative position by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and عوجًا is the direct object. [Translator's note: the source writes «الها» here, evidently for «الهاء» (the هاء).]
﴿واذكروا إذ كنتم قليلا فكثركم﴾: Also conjoined. ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as a direct object, i.e. «and remember the time of your being few». Or the object is omitted and ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for that omitted object, i.e. «and remember Allah's favour upon you at that time». The clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the تاء is its noun, and قليلا is its khabar (predicate); ﴿فكثركم﴾ is conjoined to كنتم.
﴿وانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين﴾: Also conjoined. كيف is an interrogative noun in the accusative position as the fronted khabar of كان, and عاقبة المفسدين is its noun. The interrogative has suspended (ʿallaqa) the verb of looking, so the clause is in the accusative position by removal of the preposition, and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to انظروا.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿وإن كان طائفة منكم آمنوا بالذي أرسلت به﴾: The واو is a conjunction, إن is conditional, كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and طائفة is its noun; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of طائفة. The clause آمنوا is the khabar (predicate) of كان, بالذي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا, and the clause أرسلت به is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿وطائفة لم يؤمنوا﴾: طائفة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first طائفة, and the clause لم يؤمنوا is conjoined to the clause آمنوا, which is the khabar of كان. What لم يؤمنوا attaches to has been omitted, the attachment of آمنوا sufficing for it.
﴿فاصبروا حتى يحكم الله بيننا﴾: The فاء connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition, and يحكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after حتى; أن and the verb are, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اصبروا. بيننا is an adverb attached to يحكم.
﴿وهو خير الحاكمين﴾: The واو is circumstantial or resumptive. ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and خير الحاكمين is its khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), in the accusative position, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿قال الملأ الذين استكبروا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position.
﴿قال الملأ﴾: A verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿الذين﴾: A relative noun in the nominative position as an adjective (naʿt); the clause ﴿استكبروا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿من قومه﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لنخرجنك﴾: The لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; نخرجنك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يا شعيب﴾: A singular munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the accusative position; the vocative clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين آمنوا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the كاف, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿معك﴾: An adverb of place attached to the expelling, not to the believing.
﴿من قريتنا﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نخرجنك.
﴿أو لتعودن﴾: أو is a conjunction, and لتعودن is conjoined to the answer of the first oath. تعودن here is declinable (muʿrab), because it is not directly connected to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its origin is تعودونن, then the nūn was dropped because of the succession of like letters, and the واو was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. The واو is either the agent or the noun of تعود, according to the two usages.
﴿في ملتنا﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعودن or to an omitted khabar (predicate) of تعودن.
﴿قال أولو كنا كارهين﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), i.e. rebuke, and لو is conditional, merely for linkage, [expressing] the non-occurrence of a thing in the past because of the non-occurrence of another thing in it. ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and كارهين is its khabar; the clause لو كنا كارهين is in the accusative position as a ḥāl of the pronoun of the implied verb, i.e. «Shall we return even if we are unwilling?».

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿قد افترينا﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and افترينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿على الله﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) افترينا.
﴿كذبًا﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿إن﴾: Conditional.
﴿عدنا﴾: عاد is a past verb in the jussive position as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the pronoun is in the nominative position as the agent.
﴿في ملتكم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عدنا; the pronoun is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted, what precedes indicating it.
﴿بعد إذ نجانا الله منها﴾: ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿عدنا﴾, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause نجانا is in the genitive position by annexation, الله is the agent, and منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نجانا.
﴿وما يكون لنا أن نعود فيها﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ما is negating, يكون is an imperfect verb, and لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون. أن is a maṣdarī particle, نعود is an imperfect verb in the accusative by أن, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن». The clause ﴿نعود﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdarī أن, with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن نعود﴾ is the noun of يكون, i.e. «and there is not for us a returning». فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نعود﴾.
﴿إلا أن يشاء الله ربنا﴾: There are two views on this exception. The first is that it is connected (muttaṣil); on this view the exception is from the most general of times or states. The second is that it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), the implied sense then being: «but if Allah wills the return». الله is the agent of يشاء, and ربنا is a badal (substitute) of الله.
﴿وسع ربنا كل شيء﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. وسع is a past verb, ربنا is the agent, and كل شيء is the direct object.
﴿علمًا﴾: A tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent, i.e. «His knowledge encompasses all things». ﴿على الله توكلنا﴾: The clause is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial); على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكلنا, and توكلنا is a verb and its agent. [Translator's note: in the source the entry for ﴿على الله توكلنا﴾ runs on in the same line as ﴿علمًا﴾; kept as written.]
﴿ربنا افتح﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ربنا is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), and افتح is a verb of supplication.
﴿بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق﴾: An adverb of place attached to افتح, i.e. «judge between us and our people». بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun.
﴿وأنت﴾: The واو is circumstantial or resumptive, and أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿خير الفاتحين﴾: The khabar; the clause is in the accusative position as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿وقال الملأ﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿الذين كفروا﴾: الذين is a relative noun in the nominative position as an adjective (naʿt), and the clause كفروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿من قومه﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لئن﴾: The oath clause is in the accusative position as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl). The لام prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional.
﴿اتبعتم شعيبا﴾: A verb, its agent and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنكم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the كاف is its noun.
﴿إذا﴾: A particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal).
﴿لخاسرون﴾: The لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and خاسرون is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. The clause إنكم is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and it stands in place of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), as is the rule when a condition and an oath come together.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿فأخذتهم الرجفة﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent).
﴿فأصبحوا﴾: Conjoined to فأخذتهم; the واو is the noun of أصبحوا, and جاثمين is its khabar (predicate).
﴿في دارهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاثمين.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿الذين كذبوا شعيبًا﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿كذبوا شعيبًا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿كأن لم يغنوا فيها﴾: كأن is lightened from the heavy form, its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause ﴿لم يغنوا فيها﴾ is its khabar (predicate).
﴿الذين كذبوا شعيبًا﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿كذبوا شعيبًا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿كانوا هم الخاسرين﴾: كان is incomplete, the واو is its noun, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and ﴿الخاسرين﴾ is the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the khabar of الذين. [Translator's note: the source does not state the khabar of the first الذين.]

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿فتولى عنهم﴾: The فاء is a conjunction; تولى is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو»; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولى.
﴿وقال﴾: Conjoined to تولى.
﴿يا قوم﴾: An annexed munādā (the one addressed), in the accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted first-person ياء; the ياء is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لقد﴾: The لام is in the answer to an implied oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq).
﴿أبلغتكم﴾: A verb, its agent and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿رسالات﴾: A second direct object.
﴿ربي﴾: Muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿لقد أبلغتكم رسالات ربي﴾ is the object of the saying.
﴿ونصحت لكم﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.
﴿فكيف آسى﴾: The فاء is resumptive; كيف is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial); آسى is an imperfect verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being «أنا».
﴿على قوم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آسى.
﴿كافرين﴾: An adjective (naʿt) of قوم; the clause ﴿فكيف آسى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا﴾: The واو is resumptive, ما is negating, and أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿في قرية﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun.
﴿من﴾: A redundant (ṣila) particle.
﴿نبي﴾: Genitive in form, accusative by position as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا أخذنا﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction, so the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of states; thus the clause أخذنا is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with ﴿قد﴾ implied, as is the condition for a past verb occurring as a ḥāl. The implied sense is: «We did not send to any town of the destroyed towns any prophet of the prophets in any state of the states except in the state of Our having seized».
﴿أهلها﴾: A direct object.
﴿بالبأساء﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذنا.
﴿والضراء﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to البأساء.
﴿لعلهم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun.
﴿يضرعون﴾: A verb and its agent; the clause يضرعون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل, the clause لعلهم يضرعون is circumstantial, and the clause ﴿وما أرسلنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿ثم بدلنا﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay, and بدلنا is conjoined to أخذنا, falling under its ruling.
﴿مكان﴾: The mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of بدلنا.
﴿السيئة﴾: Muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿الحسنة﴾: A second direct object, and this is what prevented its [i.e. مكان's] being in the accusative as an adverb.
﴿حتى عفوا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; عفوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is in the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بدلنا. [Translator's note: the source speaks of an interpreted maṣdar from أن here, although the verb after حتى is a past verb.]
﴿وقالوا﴾: Conjoined to عفوا.
﴿قد مس﴾: قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and ﴿مس﴾ is a past verb; the clause ﴿قد مس﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿آباءنا﴾: A direct object.
﴿الضراء﴾: The agent.
﴿والسراء﴾: Conjoined to it.
﴿فأخذناهم بغتة﴾: فأخذناهم is conjoined to عفوا, and بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿وهم﴾: The واو is circumstantial, and هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا يشعرون﴾: لا is negating, and يشعرون is a verb and its agent; the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is in the accusative position as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿المص﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿كتاب أنزل إليك فلا يكن في صدرك حرج منه﴾: كتاب is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "it is a Book"; the clause أنزل إليك is a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; the ف is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يكن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; في صدرك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of يكن; حرج is its postponed noun (ism); منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of حرج; and the preposition من is causal.
﴿لتنذر به وذكرى للمؤمنين﴾: the لام is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); تنذر is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the implied أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزل; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنذر; ذكرى is nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, or as conjoined to كتاب; or genitive as conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied أن and the verb, the implied form being: "for warning and reminding"; and للمؤمنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ذكرى.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿اتبعوا ما أنزل إليكم من ربكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; اتبعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun.
﴿ولا تتبعوا من دونه أولياء﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تتبعوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا; من دونه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتبعوا, or to an omitted ḥāl; and أولياء is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قليلا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "you take heed with little heeding".
﴿ما﴾: a connective (ṣila) particle to emphasise the paucity.
﴿تذكرون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿قليلا ما تذكرون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وكم من قرية أهلكناها﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كم﴾ is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). من قرية is in the position of accusative as the tamyīz (specification) of the predicative ﴿كم﴾. The clause أهلكنا is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كم﴾. Or ﴿كم﴾ is in the position of accusative by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), through an implied verb indicated by what follows it, and the clause ﴿أهلكناها﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿فجاءها بأسنا بياتا أو هم قائلون﴾: the ف is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession. جاءها بأسنا is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿جاءها بأسنا﴾ is conjoined to أهلكناها. بياتًا is an adverb (ẓarf) with regard to the meaning, or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), meaning "passing the night". ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction. هم is the mubtadaʾ, and قائلون is the khabar. The clause ﴿هم قائلون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بياتًا﴾, so it is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فما كان دعواهم إذ جاءهم بأسنا﴾: the ف is a conjunction. ما is negating. كان is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh). دعواهم is its noun (ism). إذ is an adverb for past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعواهم﴾. The clause ﴿جاءهم بأسنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿إلا أن قالوا إنا كنا ظالمين﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), كان [Translator's note: so in the source; the sense is evidently "the khabar of كان", the word خبر appearing to have dropped out]. إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun. The clause ﴿كنا ظالمين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن. The clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿فما كان دعواهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿فلنسألن الذين أرسل إليهم ولنسألن المرسلين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; نسألن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is necessarily joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); the clause لنسألن is conjoined; الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أرسل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and it is in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun serving as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and ﴿ولنسألن المرسلين﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿فلنقصن عليهم بعلم﴾: the ف is a conjunction; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; نقصن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is necessarily joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); the clause لنقصن is conjoined; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقصن, i.e.: (We shall relate) to every one of the messengers and those to whom they were sent what transpired of their affair; بعلم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of نقصن, i.e.: "knowing the hidden depths of their states".
﴿وما كنا غائبين﴾: the و is circumstantial; ما is negating; كنا is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and غائبين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿والوزن يومئذ الحق﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; الوزن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, i.e.: "and the true weighing is existent, or established, on that day"; إذٍ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "the day when We question the messengers and those to whom they were sent"; and ﴿الحق﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of الوزن. Or ﴿الحق﴾ is the khabar, so that the adverb is attached to ﴿الوزن﴾.
﴿فمن ثقلت موازينه فأولئك هم المفلحون﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussive conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ; ثقلت is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and موازينه is the fāʿil (agent); the ف links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; هم is a second mubtadaʾ, and المفلحون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative. Or ﴿هم﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك; the clause ﴿فأولئك هم المفلحون﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ومن خفت موازينه فأولئك الذين خسروا أنفسهم﴾: the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause; من is a jussive conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); خفت is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and موازينه is the fāʿil (agent); the ف links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative and is a mubtadaʾ, and الذين is a relative noun and is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the apodosis of the jussive condition joined with the ف; the clause خسروا أنفسهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and أنفسهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بما كانوا بآياتنا يظلمون﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) خسروا; بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يظلمون, and يظلمون has been made transitive with the ب because it contains the sense of denying (takdhīb); ما is maṣdariyya; the clause كانوا has no grammatical position because it occurs after a particle relative (mawṣūl ḥarfī); and the clause يظلمون is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿ولقد مكناكم في الأرض وجعلنا لكم فيها معايش﴾: the و is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); مكناكم is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) مكناكم; جعلنا is a verb and its fāʿil; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted (word that is) the first object of جعلنا, and معايش is the second object of جعلنا; and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قليلا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "you give thanks with little thanks".
﴿ما﴾: a connective (ṣila) particle to emphasise the paucity.
﴿تشكرون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿قليلا ما تشكرون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ولقد خلقناكم ثم صورناكم﴾: the و is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); خلقناكم is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ثم is a conjunction for sequence with an interval; and صورناكم is conjoined to خلقناكم.
﴿ثم قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; للملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قلنا; اسجدوا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and لآدم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to His saying اسجدوا.
﴿فسجدوا إلا إبليس﴾: the ف is for sequence with immediate succession; سجدوا is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of exception; and إبليس is excepted from the fāʿil of اسجدوا [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in this phrase is سجدوا].
﴿لم يكن من الساجدين﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial, i.e.: "except Iblīs, in the state of refusing to prostrate"; لم is a particle of negation, jussivisation and conversion (to the past); يكن is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir); and من الساجدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكن.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿قال ما منعك ألا تسجد إذ أمرتك﴾: قال is a past verb; ما is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause منعك is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate), the meaning being: "What thing prevented you?"; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and لا is a connective (ṣila) to emphasise the sense of negation; ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it are in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "What prevented you from prostrating?"; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تسجد﴾, i.e.: "What prevented you from prostrating at the time I commanded you to do it?"; the clause ﴿ما منعك﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿أمرتك﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿قال أنا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أنا is the mubtadaʾ and خير is the khabar; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خير; the object of the saying is in the position of accusative; خلقتني is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya); من نار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خلقتني; and the clause خلقتني من طين is conjoined to the one before it [Translator's note: so in the source; the wording of the ayah is وخلقته من طين].

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿قال فاهبط منها فما يكون لك أن تتكبر فيها﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; فاهبط: the ف is a conjunction, and اهبط is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); منها is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اهبط﴾; ﴿فما﴾: the ف is a conjunction as well, and ﴿ما﴾ is negating; يكون is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, because it contains the sense of "it befits" or "it is proper"; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكون; أن together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the fāʿil of يكون; and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فاخرج إنك من الصاغرين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; اخرج is an imperative verb; إن is an abrogating particle, and the كاف is its noun (ism); ﴿من الصاغرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause of إن and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e.: "abased and humbled".

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿قال أنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause أنظرني is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إلى يوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنظرني; the clause يبعثون is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and يبعثون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿قال إنك من المنظرين﴾: قال is a past verb; إن is an abrogating particle, and the كاف is its noun (ism); ﴿من المنظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; and the clause إنك من المنظرين is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:194-194.t:
﴿إن الذين تدعون من دون الله عباد أمثالكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الذين is its noun; the clause تدعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); عباد is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and أمثالكم is a naʿt (adjective) of عباد.
﴿فادعوهم فليستجيبوا لكم إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; ادعوهم is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His saying ﴿فليستجيبوا﴾: the ف is a conjunction, the ل is the lām of command, and يستجيبوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستجيبوا; إن is conditional; كنتم صادقين is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the faṣīḥa fāʾ, i.e.: فادعوهم; and صادقين is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:195-195.t:
﴿ألهم أرجل يمشون بها﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī) together with negation; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أرجل is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يمشون بها is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿أم لهم أيد يبطشون بها﴾: أم is a conjunction in the sense of بل (rather), and the clause is conjoined to the one before it; and likewise His saying: ﴿أم لهم أعين يبصرون بها أم لهم آذان يسمعون بها﴾.
﴿قل ادعوا شركاءكم ثم كيدون فلا تنظرون﴾: the clause ادعوا شركاءكم is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ثم is a particle of conjunction and of delay (tarākhī); كيدون is conjoined to ادعوا; the ف is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تنظرون is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person is omitted.

muyesser-irab:196-196.t:
﴿إن وليي الله الذي نزل الكتاب﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿وليي﴾ is its noun; the Name of Majesty is its khabar (predicate); الذي is a naʿt (adjective) of الله; and the clause نزل الكتاب is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو يتولى الصالحين﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or a conjunction; هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause يتولى الصالحين is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:197-197.t: ﴿والذين تدعون من دونه لا يستطيعون نصركم ولا أنفسهم ينصرون﴾: conjoined to what precedes. الذين: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); تدعون: an imperfect verb, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is the implied (muqaddar) object of تدعون, i.e.: والذين تدعونهم. من دونه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied object of تدعون, and the ه is muḍāf ilayhi; لا: negative; يستطيعون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil; نصر: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the ك is muḍāf ilayhi; the و is a conjunction; لا: negative; and أنفسهم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ينصرون.

muyesser-irab:198-198.t:
﴿وإن تدعوهم إلى الهدى لا يسمعوا﴾: also conjoined; and the conditional إن, its protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وتراهم ينظرون إليك وهم لا يبصرون﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; تراهم is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ينظرون إليك is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the و is for the ḥāl; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يبصرون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause وهم لا يبصرون is also a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:199-199.t: ﴿خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين﴾: خذ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); العفو is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the two other imperative verbs are conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:200-200.t:
﴿وإما ينزغنك من الشيطان نزغ فاستعذ بالله﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional, its nūn assimilated into ما, and ما is connective (ṣila); ينزغنك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من الشيطان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نزغ﴾; نزغ is the fāʿil (agent). فاستعذ: the ف links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the apodosis after it is a request (ṭalabī); استعذ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استعذ.
﴿إنه سميع عليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); the ه is its noun; سميع عليم are its two khabars (predicates); and the clause of إن with what falls in its scope is for causation (taʿlīl) and resumption, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:201-201.t:
﴿إن الذين اتقوا إذا مسهم طائف من الشيطان﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الذين is its noun; the clause اتقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; إذا is an adverb for future time, containing the meaning of condition; the clause مسهم is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, because it comes after the adverb; ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of مسّ, and طائف is its fāʿil (agent); من الشيطان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of طائف; and إذا with its protasis and its apodosis that follows is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿تذكروا فإذا هم مبصرون﴾: the clause تذكروا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the ف is a conjunction; إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and مبصرون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:202-202.t:
﴿وإخوانهم يمدونهم في الغي﴾: the و is resumptive; إخوانهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); يمدونهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate); في الغي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يمدونهم; and the clause ﴿وإخوانهم يمدونهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم لا يقصرون﴾: ثم is a particle of conjunction and of delay (tarākhī); لا يقصرون is conjoined to يمدونهم; and لا is negative.

muyesser-irab:203-203.t:
﴿وإذا لم تأتهم بآية قالوا لولا اجتبيتها﴾: the و is a particle of conjunction; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause لم تأتهم is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; بآية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تأتهم; the clause قالوا has no grammatical position; and لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ).
﴿قل إنما أتبع ما يوحى إلي من ربي﴾: إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; أتبع is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا); ما is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يوحى, in the passive form, has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; إليّ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوحى; and من ربي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿هذا بصائر من ربكم وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون﴾: this clause is a completion of the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl), falling within its scope; هذا is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); بصائر is its khabar (predicate); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بصائر; هدى is conjoined to بصائر, and likewise رحمة; لقوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رحمة; and the clause يؤمنون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:204-204.t: ﴿وإذا قرئ القرآن فاستمعوا له وأنصتوا لعلكم ترحمون﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction and the clause after it is conjoined, the speech being part of the object of saying that was commanded. إذا is a future condition; the clause قرئ القرآن is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; القرآن is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the ف is linking; the clause استمعوا له has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استمعوا; لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ك is its noun, and the clause ترحمون is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:205-205.t:
﴿واذكر ربك في نفسك تضرعا وخيفة﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكر is an imperative verb; ربك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في نفسك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); تضرعًا and خيفة are two mafʿūl li-ajlihi (objects of purpose), or two maṣdars (verbal nouns) standing in the place of the ḥāl, i.e.: humbly entreating, fearing.
﴿ودون الجهر من القول بالغدو والآصال ولا تكن من الغافلين﴾: the و is a conjunction; دون is an adverb attached to an omitted element conjoined to ﴿في نفسك﴾, i.e.: in secret and in the open [Translator's note: so in the source; دون الجهر means "below loudness", so "in the open" (في الجهر) appears not to match the wording of the ayah]; من القول is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; بالغدو والآصال: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اذكر; the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكن is a defective imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; and من الغافلين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:206-206.t:
﴿إن الذين عند ربك لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ويسبحونه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الذين is its noun; عند ربك is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, with no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; the clause لا يستكبرون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; عن عبادته is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستكبرون; and يسبحونه is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وله يسجدون﴾: the و is a conjunction; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسجدون; and يسجدون is conjoined to يسبحونه. Or the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause after it is in the position of an accusative; or the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause يسبحونه is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: وهم يسبحونه.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿ولو أن أهل القرى﴾: The واو is parenthetical, لو is conditional, أنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), أهل is its noun, and القرى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿آمنوا﴾: A verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
﴿واتقوا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آمنوا. أنّ and what follows it are the agent of an omitted verb, i.e. «their faith were established».
﴿لفتحنا﴾: The لام occurs in the answer to لو, and فتحنا is a verb and its agent; the clause ﴿لفتحنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿عليهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فتحنا.
﴿بركات﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من السماء﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of بركات.
﴿والأرض﴾: Conjoined to السماء.
﴿ولكن كذبوا﴾: The واو is circumstantial, لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative, and كذبوا is a verb and its agent; the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأخذناهم﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and أخذناهم is a verb, its agent and its direct object.
﴿بما﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخذناهم; ما is maṣdarī or relative.
﴿كانوا يكسبون﴾: كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يكسبون is the khabar. The clause of كان is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, on considering ﴿ما﴾ relative; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī, and together with ﴿كانوا﴾ it is, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive by the باء. The clause ﴿ولو أن أهل القرى...﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿أفأمن أهل القرى﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval and reproach (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-tawbīkhī), the فاء is a conjunction, ﴿أمن أهل﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and القرى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause is conjoined to ﴿فأخذناهم بغتة﴾.
﴿أن يأتيهم﴾: أن is maṣdarī, and it together with what falls within its scope is the object of أمن.
﴿بأسنا﴾: The agent of يأتيهم.
﴿بياتًا﴾: A ḥāl (circumstantial) or an adverb.
﴿وهم نائمون﴾: The واو is circumstantial, and هم نائمون are a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in يأتيهم.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿أوأمن أهل القرى﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval and reproach, the واو is a conjunction coordinating with ﴿أفأمن أهل القرى﴾, ﴿أمن أهل﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and القرى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أن يأتيهم﴾: أن is maṣdarī, and it together with what falls within its scope is the object of أمن.
﴿بأسنا﴾: The agent of يأتيهم.
﴿ضحى﴾: An adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتيهم﴾.
﴿وهم يلعبون﴾: The واو is circumstantial, and هم يلعبون are a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in يأتيهم.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿أفأمنوا مكر الله﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval and reproach, the فاء is a conjunction, and ﴿أمنوا مكر الله﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فلا يأمن مكر الله﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, لا is negating, and ﴿يأمن مكر الله﴾ is a verb and its direct object; the Divine Name is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إلا﴾: A particle of restriction.
﴿القوم﴾: The agent.
﴿الخاسرون﴾: An adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿أولم يهد﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), the واو is a conjunction, لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and يهد is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾.
﴿للذين يرثون الأرض﴾: للذين is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يهد, and the clause ﴿يرثون الأرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿من بعد أهلها﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يرثون; أهلها is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أن لو نشاء﴾: أن is lightened from the heavy form; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), omitted, and the clause ﴿لو نشاء...﴾ is its khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن لو نشاء﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of يهد, and the object is omitted, the implied sense being: «Has it not guided – i.e. made clear and plain – to the inheritors their outcome and the end of their affair, [namely] Our afflicting them for their sins if We willed that?». Or the agent of ﴿يهد﴾ is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to Allah the Exalted, or referring to what is understood from the context, in which case the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن لو نشاء﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied sense being: «Has not Allah – or what befell the former nations – made clear and plain Our afflicting them for their sins if We willed that?».
﴿أصبناهم﴾: A verb, its agent and its direct object.
﴿بذنوبهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it.
﴿ونطبع على قلوبهم﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. It is not permissible to conjoin it to the answer of ﴿لو﴾, because that would lead to the sealing being negated by what ﴿لو﴾ entails, whereas it is established for them. على قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نطبع.
﴿فهم لا يسمعون﴾: The فاء is a conjunction for the sequence of not hearing after the sealing of the heart; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يسمعون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿تلك القرى نقص﴾: تلك is a demonstrative in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject), القرى is a badal (substitute) of تلك, and the clause ﴿نقص﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of تلك. Or القرى is the khabar and the clause نقص is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), along the lines of the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴿هذا بعلي شيخًا﴾.
﴿عليك﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نقص.
﴿من أنبائها﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to نقص; the demonstrative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولقد جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾: The واو is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the واو is a conjunction and the clause after it is conjoined. The لام is the answer to an omitted oath, قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), جاءتهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), رسلهم is the fāʿil (agent), and بالبينات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءتهم.
﴿فما كانوا﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, ما is negating, كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the واو is its noun.
﴿ليؤمنوا﴾: The لام is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and يؤمنوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial; أن and the verb are, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of كان.
﴿بما كذبوا﴾: بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنوا; ما is a relative noun or maṣdarī.
﴿من قبل﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا. On ﴿ما﴾ being relative, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, and it is in the genitive.
﴿كذلك يطبع الله على قلوب الكافرين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied sense being: «with a sealing like that sealing Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿يطبع الله﴾ is a verb and its agent, ﴿على قلوب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يطبع, and ﴿الكافرين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, in the genitive with the ياء.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿وما وجدنا﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿فما كانوا ليؤمنوا﴾; ما is negating, and ﴿وجدنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿لأكثرهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (naʿt) of عهد.
﴿من﴾: A redundant (ṣila) particle.
﴿عهد﴾: The mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of وجدنا by position; or لأكثرهم is the second object of ﴿وجدنا﴾, on preferring that it is [the verb] of knowledge, not of finding.
﴿وإن وجدنا أكثرهم لفاسقين﴾: The واو is a conjunction, إن is lightened from the heavy form and inoperative, وجدنا أكثرهم is a verb, its agent and its direct object, the لام is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and فاسقين is the second direct object of وجدنا.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿ثم بعثنا﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay, and بعثنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿من بعدهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the pronoun refers to the messengers or to the nations.
﴿موسى﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بآياتنا﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بعثنا.
﴿إلى فرعون﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿بعثنا﴾.
﴿وملئه﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فرعون.
﴿فظلموا﴾: The فاء is for conjunction and sequence, and ظلموا is a verb and its agent.
﴿بها﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظلموا.
﴿فانظر﴾: The فاء is resumptive, انظر is a verb, and the agent is a pronoun.
﴿كيف﴾: An interrogative noun in the accusative position as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان.
﴿كان عاقبة المفسدين﴾: كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, عاقبة is its noun, and المفسدين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interrogative clause is in the accusative position as the object of انظر, and the clause ﴿فانظر كيف كان...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وقال موسى﴾: The واو is resumptive, and قال موسى is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿يا﴾: A vocative particle for the intermediate [distance].
﴿فرعون﴾: A singular proper-noun munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.
﴿إني رسول﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the ياء is its noun, and رسول is its khabar (predicate).
﴿من رب العالمين﴾: من رب is a preposition and its genitive noun, and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿وقال موسى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿حقيق﴾: حقيق is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «I am worthy»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿على أن لا أقول﴾: على is a preposition, أن is maṣdarī and governs the accusative, لا is negating, and أقول is an imperfect verb in the accusative; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, ﴿أنا﴾.
﴿على الله﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقول.
﴿إلا﴾: A particle of restriction.
﴿الحق﴾: An adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. «except the true saying»; or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because it contains the meaning of a clause.
﴿قد جئتكم﴾: The clause is an adjective of رسول; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and جئتكم is a verb, its agent and its direct object.
﴿ببينة﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جئتكم.
﴿من ربكم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of بينة.
﴿فأرسل معي بني إسرائيل﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, أرسل is an imperative verb, معي is an adverb attached to أرسل, and بني إسرائيل is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿قال إن كنت جئت بآية﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position, and the conditional clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). إن is conditional, كنت is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the تاء is its noun, and the clause جئت is the khabar (predicate) of كنت; بآية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئت.
﴿فأت بها إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: The فاء connects the answer; أت is an imperative verb, and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it. كنت is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the تاء is its noun, and it is in the jussive position as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of كنت. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e. «then bring it».

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿فألقى﴾: The فاء is a conjunction for sequence, and ألقى is a past verb.
﴿عصاه﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فإذا﴾: The فاء is also a conjunction, and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya).
﴿هي﴾: The mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ثعبان﴾: The khabar (predicate).
﴿مبين﴾: An adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿ونزع يده﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and نزع يده is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فإذا﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya).
﴿هي﴾: The mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بيضاء﴾: The khabar (predicate).
﴿للناظرين﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) بيضاء, or attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of بيضاء.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿قال الملأ﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿من قوم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فرعون﴾: Muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن هذا لساحر عليم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, هذا is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), ساحر is the khabar (predicate), and عليم is an adjective (naʿt); the clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿يريد أن﴾: The clause يريد is a second adjective (naʿt) of ساحر, and أن together with what falls within its scope is, as an interpreted maṣdar, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يريد.
﴿يخرجكم﴾: An imperfect verb in the accusative by أن.
﴿من أرضكم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجكم﴾.
﴿فماذا تأمرون﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and ﴿ماذا﴾ is in the accusative position as the object of تأمرون with the preposition dropped, i.e. «with what do you command?». Or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذا﴾ is a relative noun in the nominative position as the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿تأمرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿قالوا أرجه وأخاه﴾: The statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿أرجه﴾ is in the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). أرجه is an imperative verb, the همزة having been dropped for ease (tashīl), and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أخاه is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the هاء, or it is in the accusative as a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment).
﴿وأرسل في المدائن حاشرين﴾: The واو is a conjunction, أرسل is an imperative verb, and في المدائن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسل. حاشرين is an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted direct object, i.e. «men gathering the sorcerers». It is also said that it is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the object of حاشرين is omitted, i.e. «the sorcerers».

muyesser-irab:112-112.t: ﴿يأتوك بكل ساحر عليم﴾: يأتوك is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command; the واو is the fāʿil (agent), and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). بكل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوك, ساحر is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and عليم is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وجاء السحرة فرعون﴾: A verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا إن لنا لأجرًا﴾: قالوا is a verb and its agent, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, brought to give their answer, on the supposition [that someone] asked: ﴿ما قالوا؟﴾ (What did they say?). إنّ is an abrogating particle, لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate), the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and أجرًا is its khabar; the clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: the source calls أجرًا the khabar of إنّ, though by its own analysis (لنا being the fronted khabar) أجرًا would be the postponed noun of إنّ.]
﴿إن كنا نحن الغالبين﴾: إن is conditional, كنا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun. نحن is either a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿نا﴾, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a pronoun; الغالبين is the khabar. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because [the context] indicates it. [Translator's note: the third option «or a pronoun» is as written in the source; it is apparently incomplete.]

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿قال نعم﴾: The statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نعم is a particle of answer that includes the confirmation of the large reward they requested.
﴿وإنكم لمن المقربين﴾: The واو is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted that [نعم] stands in place of. ﴿إنكم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and من المقربين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
