﴿قالوا يا موسى﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position, containing the sorcerers' address to Moses.
﴿إما﴾: A particle of condition that contains the meaning of offering a choice.
﴿أن تلقي﴾: أن is maṣdarī, interpreted together with what falls within its scope as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the implied form being: «either your throwing is to be begun with»; or as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being: «and either your matter is a throwing». Or the maṣdar is in the accusative by an omitted verb, i.e. «do either our throwing or your throwing».
﴿وإما أن نكون نحن الملقين﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿قال فبما أغويتني﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the ف is a conjunction; the ب is a preposition of causality, and ما is maṣdariyya; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath, the meaning being: "So because of Your leading me astray, I swear"; or the ب is for the oath, i.e.: "So I swear by Your leading me astray that I shall surely sit", and it, together with its genitive noun, is attached to the omitted verb of oath.
﴿لأقعدن لهم صراطك المستقيم﴾: the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; أقعدن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقعدن; صراطك is accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarfiyya makāniyya); and المستقيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿ثم لآتينهم من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم وعن أيمانهم وعن شمائلهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with an interval; the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; آتينهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من بين أيديهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آتينهم.
﴿ولا تجد أكثرهم شاكرين﴾: the و is resumptive, or a conjunction, so the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined; لا is negating; تجد is an imperfect verb in the sense of "meeting", so it takes a single object, ﴿أكثرهم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and شاكرين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or it is in the sense of "knowing", and ﴿شاكرين﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿قال اخرج منها مذءوما مدحورا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; اخرج is an imperative verb; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اخرج; مذءومًا and مدحورًا are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the fāʿil (agent) of اخرج; and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لمن تبعك منهم لأملأن جهنم منكم أجمعين﴾: the لام is the one that paves the way (al-muwaṭṭiʾa) for the omitted oath; من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تبعك is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); in لأملأن the لام is the answer to the oath indicated by the paving lām, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it; and the oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. Or the لام is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and من is a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause تبعك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; لأملأن is the answer to an omitted oath, and that oath and its answer are in the position of nominative for the mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: i.e. as its khabar (predicate)], the implied form being: "As for whoever of them follows you — by Allah, I shall surely fill Hell with you"; جهنم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أملأن; and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿ويا آدم اسكن أنت وزوجك الجنة﴾: the و is a conjunction, or resumptive, and the clause after it is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle; آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; the statement is conjoined to اخرج, or (it is governed) by an implied governor, i.e.: "We said: O Adam"; اسكن is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and أنت is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil; زوجك is conjoined to the latent pronoun; and الجنة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿فكلا من حيث شئتما﴾: the ف is a conjunction; كلا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; من is a preposition, and حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كلا; and the clause ﴿شئتما﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿ولا تقربا هذه الشجرة فتكونا من الظالمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تقربا is an imperfect verb, jussive by لا, and the alif is the fāʿil; هذه is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and الشجرة is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; فتكونا: the ف is the causal fāʾ (al-sababiyya), and ﴿تكونا﴾ is a defective imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the ف, because it occurs as the answer to the prohibition; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e.: "Let there be no approaching on your part, and (so no) occurrence of wrongdoing from you". The alif is the noun (ism) of ﴿تكونا﴾, and ﴿من الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكونا﴾.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فوسوس لهما الشيطان ليبدي لهما ما ووري عنهما من سوآتهما﴾: the ف is a conjunction; وسوس is a past verb; ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) وسوس; الشيطان is the fāʿil (agent); in ليبدي the لام is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), or the lām of outcome (ṣayrūra) or consequence (ʿāqiba); يبدي is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to وسوس; ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يبدي; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ووري﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; عنهما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ووري﴾; and من سوءاتهما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وقال ما نهاكما ربكما عن هذه الشجرة إلا أن تكونا ملكين أو تكونا من الخالدين﴾: the و is a conjunction; قال is a past verb conjoined to وسوس; ما is negating; نهاكما is a past verb, the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi, and the ميم and the alif are two particles indicating the dual; ربكما is the fāʿil; عن هذه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نهاكما, and الشجرة is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is an "emptied" exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of reasons, so it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "except out of dislike", and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تكونا﴾ is genitive by annexation; ﴿تكونا﴾ is a defective imperfect verb, accusative by أن, the alif is its noun (ism), and ملكين is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أو تكونا من الخالدين﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿تكونا﴾ clause; and the clause ﴿ما نهاكما﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وقاسمهما إني لكما لمن الناصحين﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause after it is conjoined to the clause ﴿قال ما نهاكما﴾. قاسمهما is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), while the ميم and the alif are two particles indicating the dual. إن is an abrogating particle, and the ياء is its noun (ism). لكما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿الناصحين﴾. The لام is the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa). من الناصحين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن. The clause ﴿إني لكما لمن الناصحين﴾ is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿فدلاهما بغرور﴾: the ف is a conjunction; دلاهما is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بغرور is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "accompanied by deception", so the fāʾ is for accompaniment [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle of accompaniment here is evidently the bāʾ of بغرور]; or they are attached to دلاهما, in which case it is for mere causality, i.e.: "he lowered them because of his deceiving them".
﴿فلما ذاقا الشجرة بدت لهما سوآتهما﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya ẓarfiyya), or a particle merely for linking; ذاقا الشجرة is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ذاقا is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause بدت لهما has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بدت; and سوءاتهما is the fāʿil of بدت.
﴿وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة﴾: the و is a conjunction; طفقا is one of the verbs of commencing (afʿāl al-shurūʿ), the alif is its noun (ism), and the clause يخصفان is its khabar (predicate); ﴿عليهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; من ورق الجنة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخصفان, and الجنة is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وناداهما ربهما ألم أنهكما عن تلكما الشجرة﴾: the و is resumptive. ناداهما ربهما is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil. The clause ﴿ألم أنهكما﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. The hamza is for interrogation. عن تلكما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنهكما﴾. الشجرة is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative. The clause ﴿نادهما ربهما﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the ayah reads ناداهما] is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأقل لكما إن الشيطان لكما عدو مبين﴾: the و is a conjunction; أقل is an imperfect verb conjoined to the verb made jussive by لم; لكما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أقل﴾; إن is an abrogating particle, الشيطان is its noun, and عدو is its khabar; لكما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عدو﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of عدو and was placed before it; مبين is a naʿt of عدو; and the clause of إن and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قالا ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قالا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), with the vocative particle omitted; ظلمنا is a verb and its fāʿil, and أنفسنا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussivisation; تغفر is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغفر; ترحمنا is conjoined to تغفر; in لنكونن the لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath; نكونن is a defective imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); من الخاسرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause نكونن is the answer to the oath; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قال اهبطوا بعضكم لبعض عدو﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; اهبطوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause اهبطوا is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); بعضكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); لبعض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) عدوّ, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it; عدو is the khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is a ḥāl from the و in اهبطوا.
﴿ولكم في الأرض مستقر ومتاع إلى حين﴾: the و is a conjunction; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مستقر; مستقر is the postponed mubtadaʾ; متاع is conjoined to مستقر; and إلى حين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of متاع, i.e.: "extending until a time".

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿قال فيها تحيون وفيها تموتون ومنها تخرجون﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحيون; تحيون is an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); what follows it is conjoined to it; and the whole clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of Allah the Exalted.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿يا بني آدم قد أنزلنا عليكم لباسا يواري سوآتكم وريشا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and بني آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أنزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا; لباسًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يواري سوءاتكم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿لباسًا﴾; and ريشًا is conjoined to ﴿لباسًا﴾.
﴿ولباس التقوى ذلك خير﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the و is circumstantial and the clause is in the position of accusative; لباس is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and التقوى is the muḍāf ilayhi; ذلك is a demonstrative and a second mubtadaʾ, and خير is the khabar (predicate) of ذلك; the link (rābiṭ) is the demonstrative; and the clause ذلك خير is the khabar of ﴿لباس﴾.
﴿ذلك من آيات الله لعلهم يذكرون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it serves to emphasise what preceded; ذلك is the mubtadaʾ; من آيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause يذكرون is its khabar; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يا بني آدم لا يفتننكم الشيطان﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and بني آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; لا is prohibitive; يفتننكم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by لا; the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الشيطان is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿كما أخرج أبويكم من الجنة﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "let him not tempt you with a temptation like his expelling your parents from the Garden"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿أخرج﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿أخرج﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿أخرج﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أبويكم﴾ is the object of أخرج; and ﴿من الجنة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرج.
﴿ينزع عنهما لباسهما ليريهما سوآتهما﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿أخرج﴾ referring to Satan, or from the two parents; عنهما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينزع; لباسهما is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ليريهما﴾: the لام is for giving the reason (taʿlīl), and يريهما is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; the dual pronoun ﴿هما﴾ is in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ينزع; and سوءاتهما is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنه يراكم هو وقبيله﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause يراكم is its khabar (predicate); ﴿هو﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the nominative pronoun in ﴿يراكم﴾, and قبيله is conjoined to the nominative pronoun; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, indicated by the context of the speech.
﴿من حيث لا ترونهم﴾: من حيث is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يراكم, and the clause لا ترونهم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿إنا جعلنا الشياطين أولياء للذين لا يؤمنون﴾: the clause gives the reason for what preceded; إن is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause جعلنا is its khabar; الشياطين is the first mafʿūl bihi, and أولياء is the second mafʿūl bihi; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أولياء; and the clause لا يؤمنون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وإذا فعلوا فاحشة قالوا وجدنا عليها آباءنا﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction (joining it) to the ṣila before it; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, which is قالوا; the clause فعلوا is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); فاحشة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; وجدنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿آباءنا﴾; آباءنا is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa; and the clause وجدنا عليها آباءنا is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿والله أمرنا بها﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause أمرنا بها is the khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause, i.e.: "and they said: Allah has commanded us to do it".
﴿قل إن الله لا يأمر بالفحشاء أتقولون على الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause of إن and what falls within its scope is accusative as the object of the saying; إن is an abrogating particle, the Word of Majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism), and the clause لا يأمر is its khabar; بالفحشاء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأمر﴾; the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation; تقولون is an imperfect verb in the nominative; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تقولون﴾; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; and the clause لا تعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قل أمر ربي بالقسط﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause أمر ربي is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and بالقسط is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمر.
﴿وأقيموا وجوهكم عند كل مسجد﴾: the و is a conjunction; أقيموا is an imperative verb; وجوهكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أقيموا; عند is an adverb of place attached to أقيموا; and كل مسجد is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وادعوه مخلصين له الدين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ادعوه is an imperative verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; مخلصين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مخلصين; and الدين is the object of مخلصين, because it is an active participle.
﴿كما بدأكم تعودون﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "you will return with a returning like His originating you"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿بدأكم﴾ is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿بدأكم﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿بدأكم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿تعودون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause ﴿تعودون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فريقا هدى وفريقا حق عليهم الضلالة﴾: فريقًا is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of هدى; the second فريقًا is accusative by an implied verb indicated by His saying ﴿حق عليهم الضلالة﴾, i.e.: "and He led astray a group against whom (error) was due"; the verbal clause and the clause conjoined to it are in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of بدأكم, i.e.: "He originated you, being One who guides a group and leads astray a group"; or the two clauses are resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause حق عليهم الضلالة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿فريقًا﴾.
﴿إنهم اتخذوا الشياطين أولياء من دون الله﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿اتخذوا الشياطين﴾ is the khabar (predicate); الشياطين is the first mafʿūl bihi of اتخذوا, and أولياء is its second object; and من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ويحسبون أنهم مهتدون﴾: the و is a conjunction, or circumstantial; أن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun; أن and what falls within its scope stand in the place of the two objects of يحسبون; and مهتدون is the khabar of أنهم.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿قال ألقوا﴾: The clause of the saying is in the accusative position as the object of his saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿قال ألقوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما﴾: The فاء is resumptive, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya).
﴿ألقوا﴾: A verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿سحروا﴾ is the answer of لما.
﴿أعين الناس﴾: أعين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿فلما ألقوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واسترهبوهم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سحروا.
﴿وجاءوا بسحر عظيم﴾: Also conjoined; بسحر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاءوا, and عظيم is an adjective (naʿt) of سحر.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿وأوحينا﴾: The واو is resumptive, and أوحينا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿إلى موسى﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا.
﴿أن﴾: Explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters; the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdarī, and together with what it enters upon it is, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿ألق﴾ is then the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ألق﴾: An imperative verb, and its agent is latent (mustatir).
﴿عصاك﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿وأوحينا إلى موسى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا هي﴾: The فاء is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted that the context requires, the implied form being «so he threw it, and behold, it…»; إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya), and هي is a detached pronoun in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تلقف﴾: An imperfect verb, and the agent is latent. The clause ﴿تلقف﴾ is in the nominative position as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هي﴾.
﴿ما﴾: A relative noun meaning «that which», and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «that which they fabricate»; or maṣdarī, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar in the accusative as the object of ﴿تلقف﴾.
﴿يأفكون﴾: An imperfect verb, and the واو is the agent. The clause ﴿يأفكون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿فوقع الحق﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and وقع الحق is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿وبطل﴾: A past verb.
﴿ما﴾: Relative or maṣdarī; it is in the nominative position as the agent, or [is so] together with what falls within its scope.
﴿كانوا يعملون﴾: كان is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يعملون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:119-119.t: ﴿فغلبوا هنالك وانقلبوا صاغرين﴾: The فاء is a conjunction; غلبوا is a past verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). هنالك is a demonstrative in the accusative position as an adverb of place; انقلبوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to غلبوا, and صاغرين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿وأُلقي السحرة ساجدين﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; السحرة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of أُلقي, and ساجدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of السحرة.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t: ﴿قالوا آمنا برب العالمين﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e. «they were thrown down, prostrating, saying». The clause آمنا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and برب العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿رب﴾: A badal (substitute) of رب العالمين, or an adjective (naʿt) of it.
﴿موسى﴾: Muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وهارون﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to موسى, in the genitive.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿قال فرعون آمنتم﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿آمنتم﴾ is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). It is [read] with a single همزة, followed by the alif that is the first radical (fāʾ) of the word.
﴿به﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنتم.
﴿قبل أن﴾: An adverb of time, also attached to آمنتم; أن and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar in the genitive by annexation [to قبل].
﴿آذن﴾: Its origin is أأذن, and it is an imperfect verb in the accusative by أن. The first همزة is the همزة of the speaker that enters the imperfect, and the second was changed to an alif because it occurs vowelless after another همزة.
﴿لكم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آذن; the clause آمنتم is in the accusative position as the object of his saying.
﴿إن هذا لمكر مكرتموه﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle, هذا is its noun, the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مكر is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿مكرتموه﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of مكر.
﴿في المدينة﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مكرتموه.
﴿لتخرجوا منها﴾: The لام is causal (lām al-taʿlīl), and تخرجوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; أن and the verb are, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مكرتموه. منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخرجوا.
﴿أهلها﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فسوف تعلمون﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, سوف is a particle of the future, and تعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); its object is omitted because it is known, i.e. «you will know what calamities of punishment will befall you».

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿لأقطعن أيديكم﴾: The لام occurs in the answer to an implied oath. أقطعن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. The clause ﴿أقطعن﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. أيديكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأرجلكم﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أيديكم.
﴿من خلاف﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «opposite»; or ﴿من﴾ is causal, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb itself.
﴿ثم لأصلبنكم أجمعين﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay, لأصلبنكم is conjoined to لأقطعن, and أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the كاف.

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿قالوا إنا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; إنّ and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إلى ربنا﴾: Attached to (mutaʿalliq) منقلبون.
﴿منقلبون﴾: The khabar (predicate) of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وما تنقم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, ما is negating, تنقم is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت».
﴿منا﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنقم.
﴿إلا﴾: A particle of restriction.
﴿أن آمنا﴾: أن is maṣdarī, and together with what it enters upon it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), the object of تنقم; or the maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). In any case it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh).
﴿بآيات﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنا.
﴿ربنا﴾: Muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لما جاءتنا﴾: لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); the clause ﴿جاءتنا﴾ has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿ربنا أفرغ﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position; ربنا is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), and أفرغ is a verb of supplication.
﴿علينا﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أفرغ.
﴿صبرًا﴾: A mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وتوفنا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أفرغ.
﴿مسلمين﴾: A ḥāl (circumstantial). The answer of ﴿لما﴾ is omitted, its implied form being: «when they came to us, we believed in them without hesitation». The answer clause has no grammatical position in any case.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿وقال الملأ من قوم فرعون﴾: The واو is resumptive or a conjunction; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and من قوم فرعون is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملأ.
﴿أتذر موسى وقومه ليفسدوا في الأرض ويذرك﴾: The interrogative is one of disapproval (inkārī). تذر is an imperfect verb, its agent is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). موسى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and قومه is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to موسى. The لام is causal, and يفسدوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; the implied أن and the verb are, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تذر﴾. ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يفسدوا﴾. يذرك is conjoined to يفسدوا and is in the accusative like it; or the واو is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and ﴿يذرك﴾ is in the accusative by an implied أن after the واو in answer to the interrogative. The كاف is the direct object.
﴿وآلهتك﴾: Conjoined to the pronoun, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). The clause ﴿وقال الملأ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿قال سنقتل أبناءهم﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿سنقتل﴾ is in the accusative as the object of his saying, and أبناءهم is a direct object.
﴿ونستحيي نساءهم﴾: Conjoined.
﴿وإنا فوقهم قاهرون﴾: The واو is a conjunction or circumstantial. إنّ is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and قاهرون is its khabar (predicate); the adverb is attached to ﴿قاهرون﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿قال موسى لقومه استعينوا بالله﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿استعينوا﴾ is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿واصبروا إن الأرض لله يورثها من يشاء﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to استعينوا. إنّ is an abrogating particle, الأرض is its noun, and لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position because it is causal (taʿlīliyya). The clause يورثها is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Divine Name, or a khabar after a khabar of إنّ, and من is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يورثها.
﴿من عباده﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun.
﴿والعاقبة للمتقين﴾: The واو is resumptive, العاقبة is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and للمتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:129-129.t:
﴿قالوا أوذينا من قبل أن تأتينا ومن بعد ما جئتنا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوذينا, and أن together with what falls within its scope is, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the genitive by annexation, i.e. «before your coming». ومن بعد is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to من قبل, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar in the genitive by annexation, i.e. «after your coming».
﴿قال عسى ربكم أن يهلك عدوكم﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. عسى is a past verb, one of the verbs of hope, ربكم is its noun, the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يهلك﴾ is its khabar (predicate), and عدوكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ويستخلفكم في الأرض﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.
﴿فينظر كيف تعملون﴾: The فاء is a conjunction for sequence, and ﴿ينظر﴾ is conjoined to يستخلفكم. كيف is an interrogative in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of تعملون, and ﴿تعملون﴾ is an imperfect verb in the nominative by the retention of the nūn, the واو of the plural being the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كيف تعملون﴾ is in the accusative position as the direct object of ﴿ينظر﴾.

muyesser-irab:130-130.t:
﴿ولقد أخذنا آل فرعون بالسنين﴾: The واو is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The لام is the answer to an omitted oath, قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), أخذنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), آل فرعون is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and بالسنين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذنا.
﴿ونقص من الثمرات لعلهم يذكرون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, نقص is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السنين, and من الثمرات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقص. The clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and هذه is a demonstrative in the nominative position as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is in the accusative position as the object of their saying. [Translator's note: from «The clause قالوا…» onward this line parses words of the following ayah (7:131, ﴿قالوا لنا هذه﴾), evidently a copy-paste from the neighbouring ayah; لعلهم يذكرون is not parsed here.]

muyesser-irab:131-131.t:
﴿فإذا جاءتهم الحسنة قالوا لنا هذه﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition; the clause جاءتهم الحسنة is in the genitive position by annexation, and the clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) in the nominative position as mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is in the accusative position as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl). [Translator's note: the text is garbled here; evidently the mention of هذه («and هذه is a demonstrative in the nominative position as the postponed mubtadaʾ») has dropped out, as it appears in the previous ayah's entry.]
﴿وإن تصبهم سيئة يطيروا بموسى ومن معه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, إن is conditional, تصبهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), سيئة is the fāʿil (agent), and يطيروا is the apodosis. بموسى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يطيروا, من is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to موسى, and معه is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ألا إنما طائرهم عند الله﴾: ألا is a particle of opening and alerting, إنما is [إنّ] restrained and restraining (kāffa wa-makfūfa), طائرهم is the mubtadaʾ, and عند الله is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: The واو is circumstantial, لكنّ is an abrogating particle, and أكثرهم is its noun; the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause لا يعلمون is the khabar of لكنّ.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t:
﴿وقالوا مهما تأتنا به من آية لتسحرنا بها﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). مهما is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject); تأتنا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تأتنا, and من آية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). لتسحرنا: the لام is causal, and تسحرنا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the causal lām; نا is the direct object. The preposition and its genitive noun (the causal lām and the interpreted maṣdar after it) are attached to ﴿تأتنا﴾, and ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تسحرنا.
﴿فما نحن لك بمؤمنين﴾: The فاء connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like ليس; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مؤمنين. ﴿بمؤمنين﴾: the باء is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and مؤمنين is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative by position and genitive in form by the باء. The clause is in the jussive position as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of مهما.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t:
﴿فأرسلنا عليهم الطوفان والجراد والقمل والضفادع والدم﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا, الطوفان is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it.
﴿آيات مفصلات فاستكبروا وكانوا قوما مجرمين﴾: آيات is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the five things mentioned, and مفصلات is an adjective (naʿt). فاستكبروا is conjoined to أرسلنا. ﴿كانوا قومًا مجرمين﴾: كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, قومًا is its khabar (predicate), and مجرمين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿ولما وقع عليهم الرجز﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). وقع is a past verb, عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) وقع, and الرجز is the fāʿil (agent); the clause وقع has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿قالوا يا موسى ادع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك﴾: The clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. يا is a vocative particle, and موسى is a singular proper-noun munādā (the one addressed); ادع is an imperative verb, لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادع﴾, and ربك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ادع﴾; ما is maṣdarī or relative, and the clause عهد has no grammatical position in either case; عندك is an adverb of place attached to عهد.
﴿لئن كشفت عنا الرجز لنؤمنن لك﴾: The لام prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional. كشفت is a past verb and its agent, and it is in the jussive position as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); عنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كشفت, and الرجز is the direct object. لنؤمنن: the لام is the answer to the oath, and نؤمنن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is connected to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نؤمنن.
﴿ولنرسلن معك بني إسرائيل﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; معك is an adverb of place attached to نرسلن, and بني إسرائيل is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t:
﴿فلما كشفنا عنهم الرجز﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); the clause كشفنا has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation. كشفنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), الرجز is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كشفنا.
﴿إلى أجل هم بالغوه إذا هم ينكثون﴾: إلى أجل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and بالغوه the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is an adjective (naʿt) of أجل. إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya), هم is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ينكثون is its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:136-136.t:
﴿فانتقمنا منهم فأغرقناهم في اليم﴾: فانتقمنا is conjoined (maʿṭūf), and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) انتقمنا. فأغرقناهم: also conjoined. في اليم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أغرقناهم.
﴿بأنهم كذبوا بآياتنا وكانوا عنها غافلين﴾: بأنهم: the باء and what falls within its scope are a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أغرقناهم; the meaning of the باء is causation, i.e. «because they…». The clause كذبوا is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ, كانوا is conjoined to كذبوا, عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين, and غافلين is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:137-137.t:
﴿وأورثنا القوم الذين كانوا يستضعفون مشارق الأرض ومغاربها﴾: The واو is a conjunction or resumptive. أورثنا القوم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of القوم. The clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause يستضعفون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; يستضعفون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). مشارق الأرض is a second direct object, and مغاربها is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مشارق. The clause ﴿وأورثنا القوم...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿التي باركنا فيها وتمت كلمت ربك الحسنى على بني إسرائيل بما صبروا﴾: التي is a relative noun, an adjective of المشارق and المغارب; the clause باركنا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) باركنا. تمت كلمة ربك is conjoined to ﴿أورثنا﴾, كلمة is the agent, and الحسنى is an adjective of كلمة. على بني إسرائيل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تمت, and بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صبروا. [Translator's note: so in the source; بما, being the preposition with ما, is presumably attached to تمت, صبروا being the verb of its ṣila or the maṣdarī clause.]
﴿ودمرنا ما كان يصنع فرعون وقومه وما كانوا يعرشون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, دمرنا is a verb and its agent, and ما is a relative noun in the accusative position as the direct object. The clause كان is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the noun of كان is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, the clause يصنع is the khabar of كان, فرعون is its [i.e. يصنع's] agent, and قومه is conjoined to فرعون. ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿ما﴾, the clause كانوا يعرشون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the clause يعرشون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿يا بني آدم خذوا زينتكم عند كل مسجد﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and بني آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; خذوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; زينتكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عند كل مسجد: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) خذوا.
﴿وكلوا واشربوا ولا تسرفوا إنه لا يحب المسرفين﴾: conjoined to خذوا; لا is prohibitive; تسرفوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; إن is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun (ism), and the clause لا يحب المسرفين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قل من حرم زينة الله التي أخرج لعباده والطيبات من الرزق قل هي للذين آمنوا في الحياة الدنيا خالصة يوم القيامة﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is an interrogative noun for disapproval, and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause حرم زينة الله is the khabar (predicate) of من; التي is a naʿt (adjective); أخرج لعباده has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); الطيبات is conjoined to زينة; من الرزق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); خالصة is a second ḥāl; and يوم القيامة is an adverb attached to خالصة.
﴿كذلك نفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a detailing like that We detail the signs"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿نفصل﴾ is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿الآيات﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفصل; and the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿قل إنما حرم ربي الفواحش ما ظهر منها وما بطن﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); إنما is the restraining ما and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause ﴿حرم ربي الفواحش﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from الفواحش; the clause ظهر is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; منها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ظهر; and ما بطن is conjoined to ما ظهر.
﴿والإثم والبغي بغير الحق﴾: the و is a conjunction; الإثم is conjoined to الفواحش; and بغير الحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to البغي, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿وأن تشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; تشركوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the و is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تشركوا﴾ is conjoined; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تشركوا﴾; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لم ينزل﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and سلطانًا is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿ينزل﴾.
﴿وأن تقولوا على الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: conjoined as well; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تقولوا﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿لا تعلمون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولكل أمة أجل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أمة is the muḍāf ilayhi; and أجل is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فإذا جاء أجلهم لا يستأخرون ساعة ولا يستقدمون﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿جاء أجلهم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause ﴿لا يستأخرون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; ساعة is an adverb of time attached to يستأخرون; and لا يستقدمون is conjoined to His saying ﴿لا يستأخرون﴾, or the و is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يا بني آدم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and بني آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf.
﴿إما يأتينكم رسل منكم﴾: the statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional, assimilated into the connective (ṣila) ﴿ما﴾ which emphasises the sense of the condition; يأتينكم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; رسل is the fāʿil (agent); and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسل.
﴿يقصون عليكم آياتي﴾: the clause is likewise a naʿt of رسل; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقصون; and آياتي is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فمن اتقى وأصلح﴾: this conditional clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the previous condition, and the ف is linking; من is a conditional noun and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); اتقى is an indeclinable past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and أصلح is conjoined to اتقى.
﴿فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون﴾: the ف links the apodosis; لا is negating and inoperative (muhmala); خوف is the mubtadaʾ; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿خوف﴾; ﴿ولا﴾: the و is a conjunction and ﴿لا﴾ is negating; هم is a mubtadaʾ; يحزنون is an imperfect verb in the nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿لا خوف عليهم﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿والذين كذبوا بآياتنا واستكبروا عنها أولئك أصحاب النار هم فيها خالدون﴾: the و is a conjunction; الذين is a relative noun and is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; استكبروا عنها is conjoined; أولئك is a mubtadaʾ and أصحاب النار is its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of الذين, the link (rābiṭ) being the demonstrative; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar ﴿خالدون﴾; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, i.e.: "no one is more unjust"; أظلم is the khabar (predicate) of من; ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم; the clause افترى has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿افترى﴾; ﴿كذبا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb افترى, i.e.: "he fabricated a lie and contrived it"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: "he fabricated for the sake of lying"; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "he fabricated, being a liar", and it is an emphasising ḥāl. The clause كذب بآياته is conjoined to the clause افترى.
﴿أولئك ينالهم نصيبهم من الكتاب﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿ينالهم﴾ is the khabar; نصيبهم is the fāʿil (agent) of ينالهم; and من الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿حتى إذا جاءتهم رسلنا يتوفونهم﴾: حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, or (a particle of) inception (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition; جاءتهم رسلنا is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; the clause جاءتهم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and the clause يتوفونهم is a ḥāl from رسلنا, i.e.: "taking them in death".
﴿قالوا أين ما كنتم تدعون من دون الله﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; أين is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ; the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the تاء is the noun (ism) of كان, and the clause ﴿تدعون﴾ is its khabar; and من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or attached to تدعون.
﴿قالوا ضلوا عنا وشهدوا على أنفسهم أنهم كانوا كافرين﴾: the clause is an answer to an implied question, as though it were said: "What has become of those you worshipped and those you used to call upon?", and they answered that they had gone astray; the clause ﴿ضلوا﴾ is the object of the saying; the clause شهدوا is conjoined to the clause قالوا, or resumptive with no grammatical position; على أنفسهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شهدوا; أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهدوا; and the clause كانوا كافرين is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿قال ادخلوا في أمم قد خلت من قبلكم من الجن والإنس في النار﴾: the statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قال is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ادخلوا is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); في أمم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being among the company of nations and in their throng, accompanying them", or attached to ادخلوا, the meaning being: "among the company of nations"; the clause ﴿قد خلت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أمم; من قبلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second naʿt; من الجن والإنس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted third naʿt; في النار is a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) from His saying ﴿في أمم﴾; and it is said: attached to ﴿خلت﴾, on the understanding that the meaning is "whose entry preceded", or to an omitted naʿt of أمم, i.e.: "among nations preceding in time, being of jinn and mankind, being in the Fire".
﴿كلما دخلت أمة لعنت أختها﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time attached to ﴿لعنت﴾, containing the sense of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿دخلت﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by annexation, the implied form being: "every entering", and it is with an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "every time of a nation's entering". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified (by what follows), meaning "time" (وقت), and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which a nation entered", so that the clause ﴿دخلت﴾ is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿دخلت﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿أمة﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿لعنت﴾ is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "she" (هي), and ﴿أختها﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لعنت أختها﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the adverbial clause is part of the completion of the object of the saying.
﴿حتى إذا اداركوا فيها جميعا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, or (a particle of) inception (ibtidāʾiyya); إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis, i.e. to the coming ﴿قالت﴾; the clause اداركوا is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اداركوا; and جميعًا is a ḥāl.
﴿قالت أخراهم لأولاهم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of إذا; قالت أخراهم is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لأولاهم﴾: the لام is a preposition for giving the reason, i.e.: "concerning them", or for conveying (tablīgh), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قالت.
﴿ربنا هؤلاء أضلونا﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted; the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause أضلونا is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ربنا هؤلاء is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿فآتهم عذابا ضعفا من النار﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); آتهم is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the هاء is a mafʿūl bihi; عذابًا is a second mafʿūl bihi; ضعفًا is a naʿt of ﴿عذابًا﴾; and من النار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second naʿt.
﴿قال لكل ضعف﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and ضعف is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying of Allah the Exalted.
﴿ولكن لا تعلمون﴾: the و is circumstantial, or resumptive; لكن is an inoperative particle of rectification (istidrāk); لا is negating; تعلمون is an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; and the clause ﴿ولكن لا تعلمون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وقالت أولاهم لأخراهم فما كان لكم علينا من فضل﴾: conjoined to what preceded; قالت أولاهم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لأخراهم﴾: the لام is a preposition for giving the reason, i.e.: "concerning them", or for conveying (tablīgh), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قالت. The ف is a conjunction; ما is negating; كان is a defective past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the defective كان; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; فضل is genitive in form and the noun (ism) of كان in position; and علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun; i.e.: "We and you are equal in going astray and in deserving the punishment."
﴿فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكسبون﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e.: "if it has become clear to you and you know it, and then you persist in your contrary stance, then taste"; ﴿فذوقوا العذاب﴾ is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بما: the ب is a causal preposition, and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e.: "because of your earning"; and the clause تكسبون is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إن الذين كذبوا بآياتنا واستكبروا عنها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, and الذين is its noun (ism); the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause استكبروا is conjoined to the clause كفروا [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the ayah is كذبوا]; and عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تفتح [Translator's note: so in the source; عنها evidently attaches to استكبروا].
﴿لا تفتح لهم أبواب السماء﴾: لا is negating; تفتح is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), in the nominative; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تفتح; and أبواب السماء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولا يدخلون الجنة حتى يلج الجمل في سم الخياط﴾: this clause is conjoined to the clause لا تفتح لهم; ﴿يدخلون الجنة﴾ is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition; يلج الجمل is a verb and its fāʿil; and في سم الخياط is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يلج.
﴿وكذلك نجزي المجرمين﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it has no grammatical position. ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a recompense like that We recompense"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); and ﴿المجرمين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿لهم من جهنم مهاد﴾: the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) in the position of accusative, or resumptive with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مهاد is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and من جهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ومن فوقهم غواش﴾: conjoined; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and غواش is the postponed mubtadaʾ, the ḍamma being implied (muqaddara) on the ياء that is omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
﴿وكذلك نجزي الظالمين﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a recompense like that We recompense"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); and ﴿الظالمين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the relative noun is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and the clause عملوا الصالحات is conjoined to the ṣila.
﴿لا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها﴾: لا is negating; نكلف is an imperfect verb in the nominative, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن). نفسًا is the first object of نكلف. إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). وسعها is the second object of نكلف. The clause ﴿لا نكلف...﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) between the mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate), with no grammatical position.
﴿أولئك أصحاب الجنة هم فيها خالدون﴾: the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and أصحاب الجنة is its khabar; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and خالدون is its khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying خالدون; and the clause هم فيها خالدون is a second khabar of أولئك, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أصحاب الجنة.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل تجري من تحتهم الأنهار﴾: the و is a conjunction; نزعنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في صدورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; من غلّ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause تجري is a ḥāl from the pronoun.
﴿وقالوا الحمد لله الذي هدانا لهذا﴾: the و is a conjunction; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); الذي is a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of لله; and the clause ﴿هدانا لهذا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وما كنا لنهتدي لولا أن هدانا الله﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the و is circumstantial and the clause is a ḥāl in the position of accusative; ما is negating; كنا is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the لام is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and ﴿نهتدي﴾ is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of denial; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿كنا﴾; لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); أن is maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ being omitted; the apodosis of لولا is omitted because what precedes indicates it, the implied form being: "were it not that Allah's guidance of us is present, we would not have been guided", or "we would have been wretched"; and the whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl.
﴿لقد جاءت رسل ربنا بالحق﴾: the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); جاءت رسل ربنا is a verb and its fāʿil; and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءت.
﴿ونودوا أن تلكم الجنة أورثتموها﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نودوا is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أن is explicative (tafsīriyya), because of the sense of saying contained in calling; ﴿تلكم الجنة﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ, الجنة is the khabar, and the clause ﴿أورثتموها﴾ is a ḥāl; or الجنة is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative, and the clause ﴿أورثتموها﴾ is the khabar; and the clause ﴿تلكم الجنة...﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿بما كنتم تعملون﴾: the ب is a causal preposition, and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e.: "because of your deeds"; كنتم: كان is a defective past verb and ﴿تم﴾ is its noun, and the clause تعملون is the khabar of كنتم.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ونادى أصحاب الجنة أصحاب النار﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أصحاب الجنة is the fāʿil (agent) of نادى, and أصحاب النار is its object.
﴿أن قد وجدنا ما وعدنا ربنا حقا﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya); the clause ﴿قد وجدنا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is explicative; ما is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وعدنا ربنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and حقًّا is the second mafʿūl bihi of وجدنا.
﴿فهل وجدتم ما وعد ربكم حقا قالوا نعم﴾: the ف is a conjunction; هل is an interrogative particle; وجدتم is a verb and its fāʿil; ما is a relative (noun) and the first object; ﴿وعد ربكم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿وعد﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; حقا is the second object; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نعم is a particle of answer, and the omitted answer clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فأذن مؤذن بينهم أن لعنة الله على الظالمين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; ﴿أذن مؤذن﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; أن is explicative; لعنة الله: (لعنة) is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿على الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of لعنة; and the clause ﴿لعنة الله على الظالمين﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿الذين يصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا﴾: الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الظالمين, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "they are those who turn away"; the clause يصدون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; عن سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصدون; يبغونها is conjoined to يصدون, and it is an imperfect verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and عوجًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "crooked".
﴿وهم بالآخرة كافرون﴾: the و is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; بالآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كافرون﴾; كافرون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وبينهما حجاب وعلى الأعراف رجال يعرفون كلا بسيماهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; بينهما: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and حجاب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "and between the people of the Garden and the people of the Fire"; على الأعراف is a fronted khabar, and رجال is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause يعرفون is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of رجال; كلًّا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بسيماهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعرفوا [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the verb in the ayah is يعرفون].
﴿ونادوا أصحاب الجنة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نادوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the pronoun referring to the people of al-Aʿrāf; and أصحاب الجنة is its object.
﴿أن سلام عليكم﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya); سلام is the mubtadaʾ, and عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of سلام; and the clause ﴿سلام عليكم﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿لم يدخلوها وهم يطمعون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, as though it were said: "What was done with them?", and it was said: "They have not entered it"; the و is circumstantial; هم is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يطمعون﴾ is the khabar; and the clause ﴿وهم يطمعون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿وإذا صرفت أبصارهم تلقاء أصحاب النار﴾: the و is a conjunction; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis, which is ﴿قالوا﴾; the clause صرفت is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); أبصارهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and تلقاء is an adverb of place attached to صرفت.
﴿قالوا ربنا لا تجعلنا مع القوم الظالمين﴾: the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position; ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; لا is the lā of request, for supplication; تجعلنا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), and the attached pronoun is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مع is an adverb of place attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; القوم is the muḍāf ilayhi; and الظالمين is a naʿt (adjective) of القوم.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿ونادى أصحاب الأعراف رجالا يعرفونهم بسيماهم﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿نادى أصحاب﴾ is a past verb and a nominative fāʿil (agent). الأعراف is the muḍāf ilayhi. رجالًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿يعرفونهم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجالًا﴾. بسيماهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعرفونهم﴾. The clause ﴿ونادى أصحاب...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا ما أغنى عنكم جمعكم﴾: the clause is explicative of the calling, with no grammatical position. ما is an interrogative noun for rebuke and is a fronted object of ﴿أغنى﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is negating. أغنى is a past verb. عنكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أغنى﴾. ﴿جمعكم﴾ is the fāʿil.
﴿وما كنتم تستكبرون﴾: the و is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to ﴿جمعكم﴾, i.e.: "and your arrogance". The clause ﴿تستكبرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم. The clause ﴿ما أغنى عنكم جمعكم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿أهؤلاء الذين أقسمتم لا ينالهم الله برحمة﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of confirmation and rebuke; هؤلاء is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذين is a relative noun and the khabar (predicate); the clause أقسمتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause لا ينالهم الله برحمة has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; لا is negating; ينالهم الله is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); and برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينالهم.
﴿ادخلوا الجنة لا خوف عليكم ولا أنتم تحزنون﴾: the imperative clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e.: "it has been said to them"; and the omitted clause of saying is a second khabar of the demonstrative, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, i.e.: "that being said to them"; لا is negating and inoperative (muhmala); خوف is the mubtadaʾ — beginning with it (though indefinite) is permissible because the negation precedes it; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause ولا أنتم تحزنون is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿ونادى أصحاب النار أصحاب الجنة﴾: the و is a conjunction, or resumptive; نادى أصحاب النار is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and أصحاب الجنة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أن أفيضوا علينا من الماء أو مما رزقكم الله﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya); أفيضوا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفيضوا, and من الماء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أفيضوا as well; the clause ﴿أفيضوا...﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted (verb) conjoined to ﴿من الماء﴾, and a verb must be supplied, i.e.: "and feed us"; or, by making أفيضوا contain the sense of "throw (to us)", it becomes valid for the conjoined element to be attached to it; the clause ﴿رزقكم الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; or ﴿أو﴾ is in the sense of the و, so that it is valid. The clause ﴿ونادى أصحاب النار...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا إن الله حرمهما على الكافرين﴾: the clause [Translator's note: the source sentence breaks off here without stating the clause's status]; إن is an abrogating particle, the Word of Majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿حرمهما﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause of إن, its noun and its khabar is in the position of accusative as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); and على الكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حرمهما.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿الذين اتخذوا دينهم لهوا ولعبا﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الكافرين; the clause اتخذوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; دينهم is the first object of اتخذوا, and لهوًا is its second object; and لعبًا is conjoined to ﴿لهوًا﴾.
﴿وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا﴾: the و is a conjunction; غرتهم الحياة is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); and الدنيا is a naʿt of الحياة.
﴿فاليوم ننساهم كما نسوا لقاء يومهم هذا﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اليوم is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ننساهم; ﴿كما﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "We forget them with a forgetting like their forgetting"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿نسوا﴾ is a past verb, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿لقاء﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of نسوا; ﴿يومهم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿هذا﴾ is a naʿt of يومهم, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause ﴿نسوا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿نسوا﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is maṣdariyya, and the resulting maṣdar is conjoined to the first maṣdar; كانوا is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), the و is its noun (ism), and the clause يجحدون is its khabar (predicate); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يجحدون﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ولقد جئناهم بكتاب فصلناه على علم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); جئناهم is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath; بكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئناهم; the clause فصلناه is a naʿt (adjective) of الكتاب; and على علم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), either from the fāʿil in ﴿فصلناه﴾, i.e.: "We detailed it, knowing its detailing", or from the object, i.e.: "We detailed it, containing knowledge".
﴿هدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون﴾: هدى and رحمة are a ḥāl from the object of فصلناه, i.e.: "guiding and showing mercy"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: "We detailed it for the sake of guidance and mercy"; لقوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun); and the clause يؤمنون is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿هل ينظرون إلا تأويله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; هل is an interrogative particle in the sense of negation and disapproval, i.e.: "they await and expect nothing other than that"; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and تأويله is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يوم يأتي تأويله يقول الذين نسوه من قبل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقول; the clause يأتي تأويله is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); تأويله is the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي; يقول الذين is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause نسوه is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسوه, i.e.: "before the coming of its fulfilment".
﴿قد جاءت رسل ربنا بالحق﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); جاءت رسل ربنا is a verb and its fāʿil; and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءت.
