﴿فهل لنا من شفعاء فيشفعوا لنا﴾: the ف is a conjunction; هل is an interrogative particle; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; شفعاء is genitive by من in form, in the position of nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the ف is the fāʾ of causality (sababiyya), because it occurs in the answer to the interrogation; يشفعوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the ف; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to شفعاء, i.e.: "Are there then for us intercessors, and so intercession from them on our behalf?"; and لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يشفعوا.
﴿أو نرد فنعمل غير الذي كنا نعمل﴾: أو is a conjunction; نرد is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the clause is conjoined to the clause before it, falling with it under the scope of the interrogation, as though it were said: "Are there for us any intercessors, or shall we be sent back?" نرد is nominative because it occurs in the place of a noun, so it is a case of conjoining an interpreted noun to an explicit noun, i.e.: "Are there then for us intercessors, and so intercession from them on our behalf?" The ف is likewise for causality; نعمل is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the ف, in the answer to the second interrogation; ﴿غير﴾ is the object of نعمل, and الذي is the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause كنا نعمل is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿كنا﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), and the clause نعمل is the khabar of كنا.
﴿قد خسروا أنفسهم وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); خسروا is a verb and its fāʿil, and أنفسهم is a mafʿūl bihi; ضل عنهم is conjoined to خسروا; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضل; ما is a relative noun and is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كانوا يفترون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يفترون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿إن ربكم الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, ربكم is its noun (ism), and ﴿الله﴾ is its khabar (predicate); الذي is a relative noun in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الله﴾; the clause خلق السماوات والأرض is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; and في ستة أيام is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق.
﴿ثم استوى على العرش﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; استوى is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and على العرش is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استوى.
﴿يغشي الليل النهار﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); الليل is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يغشى, and النهار is the second mafʿūl bihi, or the reverse, i.e.: "He makes the night overtake the day, or the day the night".
﴿يطلبه﴾: the clause is a ḥāl from الليل, i.e.: "it covers the day, seeking it", or a ḥāl from النهار, i.e.: "being sought"; and يطلبه is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿حثيثا﴾: a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يطلبه, i.e.: "urging on"; or from its object, i.e.: "urged on"; or a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), so that it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: "a swift seeking".
﴿والشمس والقمر والنجوم﴾: the three words are accusative, conjoined to السماوات والأرض.
﴿مسخرات﴾: a ḥāl from them.
﴿بأمره﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مسخرات, or to an omitted ḥāl, the ب then being for accompaniment, i.e.: "accompanying His command, not departing from it in its subjection".
﴿ألا له الخلق والأمر﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ألا is a particle of opening and alerting (istiftāḥ wa-tanbīh); له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الخلق is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and الأمر is conjoined to it.
﴿تبارك الله رب العالمين﴾: another resumptive statement with no grammatical position; تبارك is a past verb, and it is a rigid (jāmid) verb that is not conjugated; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; and رب العالمين is a naʿt, or a badal (substitute) from ﴿الله﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿ادعوا ربكم تضرعا وخفية إنه لا يحب المعتدين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ادعوا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ربكم﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تضرعًا is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "possessed of humility"; or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "call upon Him with a supplication of humility"; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); خفية is conjoined to it; the clause ﴿إنه لا يحب المعتدين﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), falling under the ruling of the resumptive (clause), with no grammatical position; and the clause لا يحب المعتدين is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿ولا تفسدوا في الأرض بعد إصلاحها﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تفسدوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تفسدوا; بعد is an adverb also attached to تفسدوا; and إصلاحها is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وادعوه خوفا وطمعا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; خوفًا and طمعًا are accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "fearing and hoping"; or as being attributes of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); or as being two mafʿūls li-ajlihi (objects of purpose).
﴿إن رحمت الله قريب من المحسنين﴾: the clause gives the reason for what was mentioned; إن is an abrogating particle, ﴿رحمت الله﴾ is its noun (ism), and قريب is its khabar (predicate); and من المحسنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قريب.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وهو الذي يرسل الرياح بشرا بين يدي رحمته﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the statement is conjoined to what precedes it, namely: إن ربكم... etc.; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate); the clause يرسل الرياح is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; بشرًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "bearing good tidings of fertility and growth", so it is a ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرسل.
﴿حتى إذا أقلت سحابا ثقالا سقناه لبلد ميت﴾: حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, the limit being of the sending; إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause أقلت is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the adverb is attached to سقناه, which is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); سحابًا is a mafʿūl bihi, and ثقالًا is a naʿt (adjective); the clause سقناه has no grammatical position; لبلد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سقناه; and ميت is a naʿt of بلد.
﴿فأنزلنا به الماء﴾: the ف is a conjunction; أنزلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزلنا; the ب is causal and the pronoun refers to the clouds, i.e.: "We sent down the water because of the clouds"; or the ب is locative (ẓarfiyya) and the pronoun refers to the dead land, meaning: "We sent down water in that dead land"; and الماء is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأخرجنا به من كل الثمرات﴾: the ف is a conjunction; أخرجنا is conjoined to أنزلنا; the pronoun in ﴿به﴾ refers to the water, the land or the clouds, as preceded; and من كل الثمرات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of the omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "provision" or "vegetation".
﴿كذلك نخرج الموتى لعلكم تذكرون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a bringing forth like that We bring forth the dead"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿نخرج الموتى﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لعل﴾ is an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿تذكرون﴾ is the khabar of لعل; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿والبلد الطيب يخرج نباته بإذن ربه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; البلد is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الطيب is a naʿt (adjective); the clause يخرج نباته is the khabar (predicate); and بإذن ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿والذي خبث لا يخرج إلا نكدا﴾: the و is a conjunction; الذي is the mubtadaʾ, and it qualifies an omitted (noun), i.e.: "the land which is bad"; the clause خبث is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; the clause لا يخرج is the khabar; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), because negation precedes it; and نكدًا is a ḥāl, i.e.: "scant and slow"; or accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. it is a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: "except with a scant coming forth".
﴿كذلك نصرف الآيات لقوم يشكرون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "with a varying like that We vary the signs"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address; ﴿نصرف﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿الآيات﴾ is the object of نصرف; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصرف; and the clause ﴿يشكرون﴾ is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿لقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the لام is (in) the answer to the omitted oath; أرسلنا نوحًا is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and إلى قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا.
﴿فقال يا قوم اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: the ف is a conjunction; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; اعبدوا is an imperative verb, the و is its fāʿil, and ﴿الله﴾ is its object; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position; غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position, as though it were said: "you have no god other than Him"; the clause ﴿اعبدوا الله﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: the clause gives the reason for the command to worship, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun (ism), and the clause أخاف is its khabar; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخاف; عذاب is a mafʿūl bihi, يوم is the muḍāf ilayhi, and عظيم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿قال الملأ من قومه إنا لنراك في ضلال مبين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); نراك is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; في ضلال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نراك as the second object of seeing, the seeing here being mental (qalbiyya); and مبين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:138-138.t:
﴿وجاوزنا ببني إسرائيل البحر﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ببني إسرائيل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاوزنا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and البحر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فأتوا على قوم يعكفون على أصنام لهم﴾: فأتوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جاوزنا, and على قوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أتوا. The clause يعكفون is an adjective (naʿt) of قوم, على أصنام is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعكفون, and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of أصنام.
﴿قالوا يا موسى اجعل لنا إلها كما لهم آلهة﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. The clause اجعل is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اجعل, or to an omitted first direct object, and إلهًا is a second direct object. ﴿كما﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective of ﴿إلها﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun meaning «that which», ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and ﴿آلهة﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the pronoun latent in the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, i.e. «like that which is established for them, [namely] gods».
﴿قال إنكم قوم تجهلون﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the كاف is its noun, and قوم is its khabar (predicate); the clause تجهلون is an adjective of قوم, and the clause ﴿إنكم﴾ is the object of the saying.

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿إن هؤلاء متبر ما هم فيه﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle, هؤلاء is a demonstrative, the noun of إنّ, and متبر is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ما is a relative noun in the nominative position as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of متبر, and هم فيه are a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾. It is also said that the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ, متبر is its khabar fronted before it, and the clause is the khabar of إنّ.
﴿وباطل ما كانوا يعملون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, باطل is a fronted khabar, and ما is the postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿كانوا يعملون﴾: كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يعملون is the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كانوا يعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿باطل﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿متبر﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of باطل, because it is an active participle.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t:
﴿قال أغير الله أبغيكم إلها﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval and reproach (al-istifhām al-inkārī al-tawbīkhī), and غير is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «Shall I seek for you an object of worship other than the One who deserves worship?». The clause أبغيكم is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and إلهًا is a tamyīz (specification) or a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or ﴿غير﴾ is a fronted object of أبغيكم, and the كاف is in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. «Shall I seek for you other than Allah?». Or ﴿غير﴾ is a ḥāl and إلهًا is the direct object.
﴿وهو فضلكم على العالمين﴾: The واو is circumstantial, هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause فضلكم is the khabar (predicate); the whole clause is circumstantial, and على العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلكم. Or the واو is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:141-141.t:
﴿وإذ أنجيناكم من آل فرعون﴾: The واو is a conjunction or resumptive. ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: «and remember the time when We saved you». The clause ﴿أنجيناكم﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation, من آل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنجيناكم, and فرعون is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote.
﴿يسومونكم سوء العذاب﴾: The clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آل فرعون. يسومونكم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first direct object, and سوء العذاب is a second direct object.
﴿يقتلون أبناءكم ويستحيون نساءكم﴾: The clause يقتلون أبناءكم is a badal (substitute) of the clause يسومونكم, and يستحيون نساءكم is a clause conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it.
﴿وفي ذلكم بلاء من ربكم عظيم﴾: The واو is circumstantial or resumptive. في ذلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and بلاء is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of بلاء, and عظيم is a second adjective. The clause ﴿وفي ذلكم...﴾ is in the accusative position as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:142-142.t:
﴿وواعدنا موسى ثلاثين ليلة وأتممناها بعشر﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. واعدنا موسى is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ثلاثين is the second direct object of واعدنا; it contains an omitted muḍāf, its implied form being «the completion of thirty». ليلة is a tamyīz (specification), أتممناها is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to واعدنا, and بعشر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أتممناها.
﴿فتم ميقات ربه أربعين ليلة﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, تم ميقات is a verb and its agent, and ربه is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). أربعين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «it was completed, reaching this number»; or it is the object of ﴿تم﴾, because its meaning is «reached», i.e. «it reached forty nights». ليلة is a tamyīz.
﴿وقال موسى لأخيه هارون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, قال موسى is a verb and its agent, and لأخيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قال. هارون: a badal (substitute) of أخيه, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).
﴿اخلفني في قومي وأصلح ولا تتبع سبيل المفسدين﴾: The clause is the object of Moses' saying (maqūl al-qawl). اخلفني is an imperative verb and a direct object, في قومي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اخلفني, and أصلح is conjoined to اخلفني. ولا تتبع: the واو is a conjunction, لا is the prohibitive lā, and تتبع is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; سبيل المفسدين is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:143-143.t:
﴿ولما جاء موسى لميقاتنا﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya), containing the meaning of condition. The clause جاء موسى has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation. لميقاتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاء, and the لام is for specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), as you say: «I came to him on the tenth that had passed of the month».
﴿وكلمه ربه قال رب أرني أنظر إليك﴾: The واو is a conjunction, كلمه ربه is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جاء, and ربه is the fāʿil (agent) of كلمه. The clause قال has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. رب is an annexed munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; أرني is a verb of supplication, its agent is latent (mustatir), the نون is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the ياء is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the second object of the seeing is omitted, its implied form being «Yourself». أنظر is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request; the clause of the request and its answer is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنظر.
﴿قال لن تراني﴾: The clause is the object of the saying. لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative and of the future, تراني is an imperfect verb in the accusative by لن, and the ياء is the direct object.
﴿ولكن انظر إلى الجبل فإن استقر مكانه فسوف تراني﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative. انظر is an imperative verb, and إلى الجبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انظر. فإن: the فاء is a conjunction and إن is conditional; استقر is a past verb in the jussive position as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and مكانه is an adverb of place attached to استقر. فسوف: the فاء connects the apodosis, سوف is a particle of the future, and تراني is an imperfect verb; the clause is in the jussive position as the apodosis.
﴿فلما تجلى ربه للجبل جعله دكا﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective or temporal. تجلى ربه is a verb and its agent, and للجبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تجلى. جعله is a verb and its direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. دكًّا is a direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿دكًّا﴾ is the second direct object of ﴿جعله﴾, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of a passive participle, i.e. «crushed»; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), since the implied form is «He crushed it a crushing». [Translator's note: the source repeats the statement about the apodosis and first calls دكًّا simply «a direct object» before specifying it as the second object; translated as written.]
﴿وخر موسى صعقا﴾: صعقًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلما أفاق قال سبحانك﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective or temporal. The clause أفاق has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation, and the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position. سبحانك: it stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, in the accusative by an omitted verb, and the كاف is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); together with its omitted verb it is a parenthetical clause with no grammatical position.
﴿تبت إليك وأنا أول المؤمنين﴾: تبت is a verb and its agent, and إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تبت. وأنا: the واو is a conjunction, أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أول المؤمنين is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:144-144.t:
﴿قال يا موسى إني اصطفيتك على الناس برسالاتي وبكلامي﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position; the vocative clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the ياء is its noun, and the clause اصطفيتك is the khabar (predicate). على الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصطفيتك, برسالاتي is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to اصطفيتك, and بكلامي is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to برسالاتي.
﴿فخذ ما آتيتك وكن من الشاكرين﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and the clause after it has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The clause أتيتك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; كن من الشاكرين is conjoined to خذ, and من الشاكرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كن﴾.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿وكتبنا له في الألواح من كل شيء﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. كتبنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتبنا, في الألواح is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and من كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿موعظة وتفصيلا لكل شيء﴾: موعظة is a badal (substitute) of the position of ﴿من كل شيء﴾, because it is a direct object, as stated above; or ﴿موعظة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «We wrote for him those things for admonition and detailing». لكل شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تفصيلًا﴾, or an adjective (naʿt) of it.
﴿فخذها بقوة وأمر قومك يأخذوا بأحسنها سأريكم دار الفاسقين﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, or a conjunction coordinating an omitted [clause] with كتبنا, the implied form being «so We said: take it». خذ is an imperative verb, ﴿ها﴾ is the direct object, and بقوة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the agent of خذها. The clause وأمر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خذها, قومك is a direct object, and يأخذوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command. The clause ﴿سأريكم دار الفاسقين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿سأصرف عن آياتي الذين يتكبرون في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. عن آياتي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أصرف﴾, and الذين is a relative noun in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause يتكبرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتكبرون, and بغير الحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذين يتكبرون, i.e. «in the state of their being clothed in the religion that is not the truth».
﴿وإن يروا كل آية لا يؤمنوا بها﴾: The واو is a conjunction, إن is conditional, يروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the واو is the fāʿil (agent), and كل آية is the direct object. The clause لا يؤمنوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنوا.
﴿وإن يروا سبيل الرشد لا يتخذوه سبيلا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; سبيلًا is a second direct object.
﴿وإن يروا سبيل الغي يتخذوه سبيلا﴾: Also conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ذلك بأنهم كذبوا بآياتنا وكانوا عنها غافلين﴾: The demonstrative is in the nominative or accusative position. The nominative is on its being a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the preposition and genitive noun after it, i.e. «that turning-away is because of their denial»; and the accusative is on its being in the sense of «their turning away from that turning-away because of their denial», and the accusative is on its being in the sense of «their turning away from that turning-away because of their denial», so it is made a maṣdar that is a direct object. [Translator's note: the source repeats this sentence verbatim; translated as written.] In any case the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. The clause كذبوا is the khabar of أنّ, بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا, كانوا is conjoined to كذبوا, the واو is the noun of كان, عنها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين, and غافلين is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿والذين كذبوا بآياتنا ولقاء الآخرة حبطت أعمالهم﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The relative noun is in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لقاء الآخرة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بآياتنا; and the clause حبطت أعمالهم is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون﴾: The همزة is for interrogation, by which negation is meant, and that is why ﴿إلا﴾ comes after it. [Translator's note: the source says «the همزة», though the interrogative particle in the ayah is هل.] يجزون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for one whose agent is not named), and the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). إلا is a particle of restriction, and ما is a relative noun in the accusative position as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كانوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause يعملون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿واتخذ قوم موسى من بعده من حليهم عجلا جسدا له خوار﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the واو is a conjunction, of the conjoining of one story to another. قوم موسى is the fāʿil (agent), and من بعده is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتخذ. من حليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اتخذ, or to an omitted [element] in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), because had it come later it would have been an adjective (naʿt), as is the rule. عجلًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and جسدًا is a badal (substitute). له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and خوار is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the accusative position as an adjective of His word ﴿عجلا﴾.
﴿ألم يروا أنه لا يكلمهم ولا يهديهم سبيلا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and the واو is the agent of يروا. أنّ and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يروا; the clause لا يكلمهم is the khabar, and لا يهديهم سبيلًا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لا يكلمهم. سبيلًا is a second direct object, or in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿اتخذوه وكانوا ظالمين﴾: A resumptive clause, with no grammatical position. The واو is a conjunction, كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and ظالمين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿ولما سقط في أيديهم﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); سقط is built as a passive (for one whose agent is not named), and في أيديهم stands in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). في is in the sense of على, i.e. «upon their hands».
﴿ورأوا أنهم قد ضلوا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سقط في أيديهم. أنّ and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of رأوا, because it is in the sense of «they knew»; the clause قد ضلوا is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.
﴿قالوا لئن لم يرحمنا ربنا ويغفر لنا﴾: The clause قالوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The لام prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), إن is conditional, لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and يرحمنا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم; نا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ربنا is the postponed fāʿil (agent). ويغفر: the واو is a conjunction, the clause يغفر is conjoined to يرحمنا, and لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغفر.
﴿لنكونن من الخاسرين﴾: The لام is the answer to the oath, and نكونن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is connected to the heavy nūn of emphasis. The clause of the answer to the oath has no grammatical position, and the oath clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). من الخاسرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of نكونن.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿ولما رجع موسى إلى قومه غضبان أسفا﴾: The واو is resumptive or a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). The clause رجع موسى has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation. إلى قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رجع; غضبان is a first ḥāl (circumstantial), and أسفًا a second ḥāl, of موسى.
﴿قال بئسما خلفتموني من بعدي﴾: بئس: a past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], meaning «a thing», in the accusative position as a tamyīz (specification). The clause ﴿خلفتموني﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿ما﴾, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. «your succession». من بعدي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿ولما رجع...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿أعجلتم أمر ربكم﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), عجلتم is a verb and its agent, and أمر ربكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وألقى الألواح وأخذ برأس أخيه يجره إليه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, ألقى is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قال, and أخذ يجره إليه is a ḥāl of the pronoun of Moses latent in أخذ. [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently «and أخذ is conjoined [to ألقى], and [the clause] يجره إليه is a ḥāl…» is meant.]
﴿قال ابن أم﴾: ابن أمّ are two nouns indeclinable on the fatḥa because they are compounded in the manner of numbers, like خمسة عشر, or of adverbs, like صباح مساء. It is also said that ابن is annexed to أمّ, and أمّ is annexed to the first-person ياء, which was changed to an alif, as it is changed in a munādā annexed to the first-person ياء; then the alif was dropped and the fatḥa sufficed for it, just as the kasra suffices for the ياء. In that case the vowel of ابن is a vowel of inflection, and it is annexed to أمّ, which is in the genitive position by annexation. In either case the vocative particle is omitted.
﴿إن القوم استضعفوني وكادوا يقتلونني﴾: The clause serves as a reason for the way they treated him. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), القوم is its noun, and the clause استضعفوني is its khabar (predicate). كادوا is conjoined to استضعفوني, the واو is the noun of كاد, and the clause يقتلونني is its khabar.
﴿فلا تشمت بي الأعداء﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تشمت, and الأعداء is the direct object.
﴿ولا تجعلني مع القوم الظالمين﴾: The واو is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تجعلني is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; مع is an adverb of place attached to تجعلني, القوم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الظالمين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿قال رب اغفر لي ولأخي﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. رب is a munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted, اغفر is a verb of supplication, لي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اغفر, and لأخي is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لي﴾.
﴿وأدخلنا في رحمتك﴾: Conjoined to اغفر; في رحمتك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أدخلنا.
﴿وأنت أرحم الراحمين﴾: The واو is circumstantial or resumptive, أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and أرحم الراحمين the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿إن الذين اتخذوا العجل سينالهم غضب من ربهم وذلة في الحياة الدنيا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and الذين is its noun; the clause اتخذوا العجل has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause سينالهم is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. غضب is the fāʿil (agent), من ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of غضب, ذلة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to غضب, في الحياة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ذلة, and الدنيا is an adjective of الحياة.
﴿وكذلك نجزي المفترين﴾: The واو is resumptive. ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being «with a requital like that We requite». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن», and ﴿المفترين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿وكذلك نجزي المفترين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿والذين عملوا السيئات ثم تابوا من بعدها وآمنوا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding الذين, or a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause عملوا السيئات is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ثم تابوا is conjoined to عملوا, من بعدها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and آمنوا is conjoined to عملوا.
﴿إن ربك من بعدها لغفور رحيم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, ربك is its noun, and من بعدها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), غفور is the first khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾, and رحيم the second khabar; the whole clause is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ولما سكت عن موسى الغضب﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya), سكت الغضب is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and عن موسى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سكت; the clause سكت has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿أخذ الألواح وفي نسختها هدى ورحمة للذين هم لربهم يرهبون﴾: The clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The واو is circumstantial, في نسختها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), هدى is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and رحمة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to هدى. للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt); هم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يرهبون its khabar, and لربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يرهبون. The لام was brought in to strengthen [the verb's hold on] the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because the verb's coming later gives it weakness.

muyesser-irab:155-155.t:
﴿واختار موسى قومه سبعين رجلا لميقاتنا﴾: A resumptive statement. اختار موسى is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and قومه is in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. «from his people»: the preposition was dropped and the verb made to reach [the noun] directly. سبعين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of اختار, رجلا is a tamyīz (specification), and لميقاتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلما أخذتهم الرجفة﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, a direct object and an agent.
﴿قال رب لو شئت أهلكتهم من قبل وإياي﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the vocative clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). لو is conditional, شئت is a verb and its agent, and the direct object is omitted. أهلكتهم is a verb, its agent and its direct object, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أهلكتهم, and إياي is a detached pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the هاء.
﴿أتهلكنا بما فعل السفهاء منا﴾: The interrogative همزة is an indeclinable particle with no grammatical position. تهلكنا is a verb and its direct object, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. بما is a preposition and its genitive noun; فعل السفهاء is a verb and its agent, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. منا is a preposition and its genitive noun.
﴿إن هي إلا فتنتك﴾: إن is negating, هي is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and إلا is a particle of restriction.
﴿تضل بها من تشاء وتهدي من تشاء﴾: The clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e. «leading astray by it and guiding». من is a relative noun in the accusative position as the direct object, and likewise the second ﴿من﴾.
﴿أنت ولينا فاغفر لنا وارحمنا﴾: أنت is the mubtadaʾ, and ولينا the khabar (predicate). فاغفر: the فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and اغفر is a verb of supplication; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اغفر, and ارحمنا is conjoined to اغفر.
﴿وأنت خير الغافرين﴾: The واو is circumstantial or resumptive, أنت is the mubtadaʾ, and خير الغافرين the khabar; the clause is in the accusative position as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:156-156.t:
﴿واكتب لنا في هذه الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and اكتب is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فاغفر. لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اكتب, في هذه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and حسنة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). في الآخرة is conjoined to ﴿في هذه الدنيا﴾, the first object sufficing [for it].
﴿إنا هدنا إليك﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause هدنا إليك is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
﴿قال عذابي أصيب به من أشاء﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. عذابي is either a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is the clause أصيب, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, with the clause أصيب circumstantial (ḥāliyya). به is a preposition and its genitive noun, من is a relative noun, the direct object, and the clause أشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ورحمتي وسعت كل شيء﴾: Conjoined to the preceding clause. ﴿رحمتي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, ﴿وسعت﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), ﴿كل﴾ is the direct object, and ﴿شيء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فسأكتبها للذين يتقون ويؤتون الزكاة﴾: The فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The سين is a particle of the future, and أكتبها is a verb, a latent agent and a direct object. للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أكتبها; the clause يتقون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause ويؤتون الزكاة is conjoined to the clause يتقون.
﴿والذين هم بآياتنا يؤمنون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined to the preceding الذين. هم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يؤمنون its khabar, and بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنون; the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t:
﴿الذين يتبعون الرسول النبي الأمي الذي يجدونه مكتوبا عندهم في التوراة والإنجيل﴾: الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of [the preceding] الذين, or a badal (substitute) of it. The clause يتبعون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and الرسول is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); النبي is a first adjective, الأمي a second adjective, and الذي a third adjective. The clause يجدونه has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; مكتوبًا is the second direct object of يجدونه, عندهم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكتوبًا﴾, and في التوراة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يأمرهم بالمعروف وينهاهم عن المنكر﴾: The clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأمرهم, and ينهاهم عن المنكر is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.
﴿ويحل لهم الطيبات ويحرم عليهم الخبائث﴾: Conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ويضع عنهم إصرهم والأغلال التي كانت عليهم﴾: Also conjoined. إصرهم is the direct object, الأغلال is conjoined to إصرهم, and التي is an adjective of الأغلال; the clause كانت عليهم is the ṣila of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position, and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كانت.
﴿فالذين آمنوا به وعزروه ونصروه﴾: The فاء is resumptive, and الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position, به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا, and عزروه and نصروه are conjoined to آمنوا.
﴿واتبعوا النور الذي أنزل معه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and اتبعوا is also conjoined; النور is the direct object, الذي is an adjective, the clause أنزل is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position, and معه is an adverb of place attached to أنزل.
﴿أولئك هم المفلحون﴾: The nominal clause is the khabar of the relative noun. The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) or a second mubtadaʾ; المفلحون is the khabar of أولئك, or the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and [in that case] the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك. The clause ﴿فالذين آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿قل يا أيها الناس إني رسول الله إليكم جميعا﴾: A resumptive statement, with no grammatical position. قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is «أنت». يا is a vocative particle for the intermediate [distance], and أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the accusative position; ها is for alerting, and الناس is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿أي﴾. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the ياء is its noun, and رسول الله is its khabar (predicate); إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رسول, and جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of إليكم. The vocative clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض﴾: The relative noun is an adjective of الله, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and ملك السماوات والأرض is the postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لا﴾: The lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: Its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the accusative position.
﴿إلا﴾: A particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: A badal (substitute) of the position of لا and its noun, because their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal of the pronoun latent (mustakinn) in the omitted khabar. The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ has no grammatical position because it is a badal of the ṣila before it.
﴿يحيي ويميت﴾: The clause is also a badal, so it has no grammatical position.
﴿فآمنوا بالله ورسوله النبي الأمي الذي يؤمن بالله وكلماته﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and آمنوا is an imperative verb; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا, and رسوله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الله. النبي is an adjective, and likewise الأميّ. The clause يؤمن بالله has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and كلماته is conjoined to الله.
﴿واتبعوه لعلكم تهتدون﴾: Conjoined to آمنوا. لعل is an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun, and the clause تهتدون is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:159-159.t: ﴿ومن قوم موسى أمة يهدون بالحق وبه يعدلون﴾: The واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. من قوم موسى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and أمة is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause يهدون بالحق is an adjective (naʿt), as a narration of a past state (ḥikāyat al-ḥāl al-māḍiya); بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «clothed in the truth», and به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعدلون.

muyesser-irab:160-160.t:
﴿وقطناهم اثنتى عشرة أسباطا أمما﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and قطعناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). اثنتى عشرة is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of قطعناهم, i.e. «We divided them, numbered by this number»; or قطعناهم is in the sense of «We made them», so that اثنتى عشرة is a second direct object. أسباطًا is a badal (substitute) of اثنتى عشرة, and أممًا is a badal of ﴿أسباطًا﴾, so it is a badal of the badal. [Translator's note: the heading in the source reads «وقطناهم», a misprint for ﴿وقطعناهم﴾.]
﴿وأوحينا إلى موسى إذ استسقاه قومه﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قطعناهم. إلى موسى is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا, and ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, also attached to أوحينا. استسقاه قومه: a verb, a direct object and an agent; the clause ﴿استسقاه قومه﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿أن اضرب بعصاك الحجر﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of saying without its letters; the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdarī, and together with what it enters upon it is, as an interpreted maṣdar, in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; the clause ﴿اضرب﴾ is then the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. اضرب: an imperative verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir). بعصاك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اضرب﴾. الحجر: the direct object.
﴿فانبجست منه اثنتا عشرة عينا﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انبجست, اثنتا عشرة is the agent of انبجست, and عينًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿قد علم كل أناس مشربهم﴾: The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and علم كل أناس is a verb and its agent; أناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is إنسان – it is also said to be a broken plural of it. مشربهم is the direct object.
﴿وظللنا عليهم الغمام وأنزلنا عليهم المن والسلوى﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ظللنا is a verb and its agent; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظللنا, and الغمام is the direct object. أنزلنا is conjoined to ظللنا, عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزلنا, المن is the direct object, and السلوى is conjoined to المن.
﴿كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم﴾: The clause كلوا is in the accusative position as the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «and We said». كلوا is an imperative verb, and the واو is the agent; من طيبات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كلوا, and ما is a relative noun in the genitive position by annexation to طيبات. The clause رزقناكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وما ظلمونا ولكن كانوا أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: The واو is resumptive, ما is negating, and ظلمونا is a verb, its agent and its direct object. The واو is circumstantial, and لكن is inoperative and lightened. كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, and the واو is its noun; أنفسهم is a fronted object of يظلمون, and the clause يظلمون is in the accusative position as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا. The clause ﴿وما ظلمونا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿وإذ قيل لهم اسكنوا هذه القرية﴾: The واو is resumptive, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «remember». The clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. The clause اسكنوا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), هذه is a demonstrative in the accusative position as a direct object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), and القرية is a badal (substitute).
﴿وكلوا منها حيث شئتم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and كلوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اسكنوا; منها, the preposition and its genitive noun, are attached to كلوا. حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «moving about»; شئتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the genitive position by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿وقولوا﴾: Conjoined to وكلوا.
﴿حطة﴾: The khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «our request is relief» or «our matter is relief»; the nominal clause is the object of the saying. Its basic form would be the accusative, because its meaning is «relieve us of our sins», but it was turned to the nominative to indicate the permanence of the relief and constancy in it.
﴿وادخلوا﴾: An imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the واو is the agent; the clause is in the accusative position as the object of the saying.
﴿الباب﴾: The direct object.
﴿سجدًا﴾: A ḥāl.
﴿نغفر﴾: An imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command.
﴿لكم﴾: The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نغفر.
﴿خطيئاتكم﴾: The direct object.
﴿سنزيد المحسنين﴾: An imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿قال يا قوم ليس بي ضلالة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; and ضلالة is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ولكني رسول من رب العالمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle, and the ياء is its noun; رسول is the khabar of لكن; and من رب العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:162-162.t:
﴿فبدل الذين ظلموا منهم قولا غير الذي قيل لهم﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and بدل الذين is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). There is an omission in the speech: what is omitted is the second object of بدّل, its implied form being «with that which was said to them». قولا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), غير is an adjective (naʿt), الذي is a relative noun in the genitive position by annexation, and the clause قيل لهم is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأرسلنا عليهم رجزا من السماء بما كانوا يظلمون﴾: فأرسلنا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فبدّل, and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective. بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلنا; the باء is causal, and ما is a relative noun or maṣdarī. كانوا is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يظلمون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿أبلغكم رسالات ربي وأنصح لكم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of رسول; the كاف is the first object of أبلغكم, and رسالات ربي is the second object; and أنصح لكم is conjoined to أبلغكم.
﴿وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: conjoined to أبلغكم; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم, and an omitted (word) must be supplied, i.e.: "from His direction"; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause لا تعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿واسألهم عن القرية التي كانت حاضرة البحر﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and اسألهم is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). عن القرية is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اسألهم, and التي is a relative noun, an adjective (naʿt) of القرية. The clause كانت has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the noun of كانت is latent, i.e. «هي», and حاضرة البحر is the khabar (predicate) of كانت.
﴿إذ يعدون في السبت﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the genitive position as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿القرية﴾, what is meant by the town being its people; or it is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿حاضرة﴾. يعدون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿يعدون﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿إذ تأتيهم حيتانهم يوم سبتهم شرعا ويوم لا يسبتون لا تأتيهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿يعدون﴾, and the clause ﴿تأتيهم﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation; حيتانهم is the agent of تأتيهم, and شرعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of حيتانهم. يوم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إذ, and the clause ﴿لا يسبتون﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation.
﴿كذلك نبلوهم بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being «with a trial like that trial We try them». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿نبلوهم﴾ is an imperfect verb, its agent is latent, its implied form being «نحن», the هاء is the direct object, and the ميم is the sign of the plural. ﴿بما﴾: the باء is causal, and ما is maṣdarī, i.e. «We try them because of their transgression»; the clause ﴿يفسقون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; the و is a conjunction; عجبتم is conjoined to an omitted (clause) that must be supplied, i.e.: "Did you deny and wonder?"; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and together with what it governs it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "at the fact that there came to you"; ذكر is the fāʿil (agent); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ذكر, or attached to جاءكم; على رجل is a naʿt of ذكر, and an omitted (word) must be supplied, i.e.: "on the tongue of a man"; and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل.
﴿لينذركم ولتتقوا ولعلكم ترحمون﴾: the لام gives the reason for the coming; ينذركم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاءكم; لتتقوا is conjoined to لينذركم; the clause of hope is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause ترحمون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿وإذ قالت أمة منهم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding ﴿إذ﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted ﴿إذ يعدون﴾. The clause ﴿قالت﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation, أمة is the fāʿil (agent), and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of أمة.
﴿لم تعظون قوما الله مهلكهم أو معذبهم عذابا شديدا﴾: The لام is a preposition, and the interrogative ما has had its alif dropped because the preposition enters upon it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعظون. قومًا is the object of تعظون. الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and مهلكهم a khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is an adjective of ﴿قومًا﴾. أو is a conjunction, and معذبهم is conjoined to مهلكهم. عذابا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), and شديدًا is an adjective.
﴿قالوا معذرة إلى ربكم ولعلهم يتقون﴾: The clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position. معذرة is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «we admonished them for the sake of an excuse»; or it is in the accusative as a maṣdar by an implied verb from its own root, i.e. «we make an excuse»; or it is in the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إلى ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to معذرة. لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause يتقون is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿فكذبوه فأنجيناه والذين معه في الفلك﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), because it occurs as the apodosis of an omitted condition, i.e.: "If you wish to know the outcome of their affair: they denied him"; كذبوه is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فأنجيناه﴾ is conjoined to فكذبوه; the و is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and الذين is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), or conjoined to the هاء; معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, i.e.: "who were settled with him in the ship", and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and في الفلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the (notion of) settledness that is in الملك [Translator's note: so in the source; probably a slip for الفلك or for the omitted ṣila], i.e. to what the adverb is attached to, or to أنجيناه.
﴿وأغرقنا الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; أغرقنا الذين is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause كذبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كذبوا.
﴿إنهم كانوا قوما عمين﴾: the clause gives the reason for their destruction mentioned before, i.e.: "they perished because of blindness in their inner sight"; إن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun (ism); ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), the و is its noun, and قومًا is its khabar (predicate); the clause كانوا is the khabar of إن; and عمين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿فلما نسوا ما ذكروا به﴾: The فاء is resumptive, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). The clause نسوا has no grammatical position, or is in the genitive position by annexation; نسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ذكروا, built as a passive (for one whose agent is not named), has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; the واو is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذكروا.
﴿أنجينا الذين ينهون عن السوء﴾: The clause أنجينا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. الذي is the direct object, the clause ينهون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and عن السوء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينهون. The clause ﴿فلما نسوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source writes «الذي» for ﴿الذين﴾ here.]
﴿وأخذنا الذين ظلموا﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.
﴿بعذاب بئيس بما كانوا يفسقون﴾: بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخذنا, and بئيس is an adjective (naʿt) of عذاب. بما: the باء is a preposition of cause, i.e. «because of their transgression».

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿وإلى عاد أخاهم هودا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إلى عاد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb conjoined to أرسلنا; أخاهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرسلنا; and هودًا is a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) from ﴿أخاهم﴾.
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله﴾: the conjunction has been omitted from ﴿قال﴾, unlike the first ayah in the story of Noah; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; and the clause of vocative and command is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position; and غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position.
﴿أفلا تتقون﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, and the ف is for conjoining to an implied (clause), i.e.: "Do you not reflect?" or "Are you heedless, so that you do not fear (Allah)?"; لا is negating; تتقون is an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; and the و is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:166-166.t: ﴿فلما عتوا عن ما نهوا عنه قلنا لهم كونوا قردة خاسئين﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and لما is connective (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya). عما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عتوا. The clause قلنا has no grammatical position, and the clause كونوا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); قردة is the khabar (predicate) of كونوا, and خاسئين is an adjective (naʿt).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿قال الملأ الذين كفروا من قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is a naʿt (adjective); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إنا لنراك في سفاهة﴾: the clause of ﴿إن﴾ and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of the chiefs; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause نراك is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and في سفاهة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), considering the seeing to be mental (qalbiyya).
﴿وإنا لنظنك من الكاذبين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the لام is the shifted lām; نظنك is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and من الكاذبين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نظنك as its second object.

muyesser-irab:167-167.t:
﴿وإذ تأذن ربك﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb conjoined to ﴿واسألهم﴾, the implied form being «and remember the time when your Lord proclaimed». The clause ﴿تأذن﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and ربك is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ليبعثن عليهم إلى يوم القيامة من يسومهم سوء العذاب﴾: The لام is the answer to the oath understood from the verb تأذن, and يبعثن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa. عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبعثن or to تأذَّن. من is a relative noun, the object of يبعثن; the clause يسومهم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and سوء العذاب is the second direct object of يسومهم.
﴿إن ربك لسريع العقاب وإنه لغفور رحيم﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ربك is its noun, and سريع العقاب is its khabar (predicate); the clause of إنّ with its noun and khabar is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. The clause وإنه لغفور رحيم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it, and the لام is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿قال يا قوم ليس بي سفاهة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of his saying; ﴿ليس﴾ is a defective past verb; بي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); and سفاهة is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ولكني رسول من رب العالمين﴾: the و is circumstantial; لكن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun, and رسول is its khabar; and من رب العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رسول.

muyesser-irab:168-168.t:
﴿وقطعناهم في الأرض أمما﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and قطعناهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قطعناهم; أممًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a direct object; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. [Translator's note: the source parses في الأرض twice, with two different attachments; translated as written.]
﴿منهم الصالحون ومنهم دون ذلك﴾: The clause is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿أممًا﴾. منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and الصالحون is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and دون is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted qualified noun, which is the postponed mubtadaʾ. Similar to it is the saying of Allah the Exalted: [Translator's note: the source gives no verse here; what follows is the parsing of the next phrase of this ayah.] ﴿وبلوناهم بالحسنات والسيئات لعلهم يرجعون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and بلوناهم is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قطعناهم; بالحسنات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بلوناهم, and السيئات is conjoined to الحسنات. لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause يرجعون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿أبلغكم رسالات ربي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of رسول; ﴿أبلغكم﴾ is a verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the كاف is the first object of أبلغكم, and رسالات ربي is its second object.
﴿وأنا لكم ناصح أمين﴾: the و is a conjunction; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ناصح; ناصح is the first khabar (predicate) of أنا, and أمين is the second khabar of أنا, or a naʿt of ناصح.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿أوعجبتم أن جاءكم ذكر من ربكم على رجل منكم لينذركم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation, intended as a prohibition, i.e.: "Do not wonder, and reflect upon your affair"; the و is a conjunction; عجبتم is a past verb, the تاء is the fāʿil (agent), and the ميم is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿عجبتم﴾ is conjoined to an implied resumptive (clause) indicated by the context of the speech, i.e.: "Did you then deny and wonder?"; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن جاءكم﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عجبتم﴾, i.e.: "Do you wonder at the coming of a reminder from your Lord?"; ذِكْر is the fāʿil of جاءكم; من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ذِكْر; على رجل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿ذِكْر﴾, i.e.: "spoken on the tongue of a man"; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل; ﴿لينذركم﴾: the لام is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and ينذركم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the maṣdar is genitive by the لام, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاءكم.
﴿واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد قوم نوح﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "and remember the time when He made you"; and the clause is conjoined to an implied (clause), as though it were said: "Do not wonder", or "Reflect upon your affair, gain insight, and remember". The clause ﴿جعلكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); جعلكم is a past verb, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the كاف is the first mafʿūl bihi; خلفاء is the second object; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿خلفاء﴾; ﴿قوم﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself a muḍāf; and ﴿نوح﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وزادكم في الخلق بسطة﴾: conjoined to جعلكم; في الخلق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); بسطة is the second mafʿūl bihi of زادكم, or a tamyīz (specification); and the كاف is the first object.
﴿فاذكروا آلاء الله لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), because it occurs as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "If you have known this with true knowledge, reflected upon it, and gained insight into its outcomes and hidden aspects, then remember"; آلاء الله is a mafʿūl bihi; لعل is an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun (ism), and the clause تفلحون is the khabar (predicate) of لعل; and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿قالوا أجئتنا لنعبد الله وحده ونذر ما كان يعبد آباؤنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; جئتنا is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the لام is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); نعبد is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the لام; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتنا; ﴿الله﴾ is its object; وحده is an interpreted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "alone"; نذر is an imperfect verb conjoined to نعبد; ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; كان is a defective past verb, and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir); the clause يعبد آباؤنا is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان; and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); أتِ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); نا is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ائتنا﴾; the clause تعدنا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; كنت is a defective past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كنت is a defective past verb, an abrogator (nāsikh), and the تاء is its noun; من الصادقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of إن is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e.: "then bring us".

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قال قد وقع عليكم من ربكم رجس وغضب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); وقع is a past verb; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) وقع; رجس is the fāʿil (agent); من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجس; غضب is conjoined to رجس; and the clause of قد and what falls within its scope is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أتجادلونني في أسماء سميتموها أنتم وآباؤكم﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation; تجادلونني is an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في أسماء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجادلونني; the clause سميتموها is a naʿt of أسماء; the و is for saturating (lengthening) the ḍamma; أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis); and آباؤكم is conjoined to أنتم.
﴿ما نزل الله بها من سلطان﴾: the clause ما نزَّل is a second naʿt of أسماء; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نزل, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and سلطان is genitive in form and accusative in position as an object.
﴿فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); انتظروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; إن is an abrogating particle, and the ياء is its noun (ism); معكم is an adverb attached to المنتظرين; and من المنتظرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿فأنجيناه والذين معه برحمة منا﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), i.e.: "So what happened happened, and We saved him"; أنجيناه is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is conjoined to the هاء in أنجيناه, or is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; برحمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنجيناه; and منّا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة.
﴿وقطعنا دابر الذين كذبوا بآياتنا وما كانوا مؤمنين﴾: the و is a conjunction; قطعنا is conjoined to أنجيناه; دابر is a mafʿūl bihi; الذين is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause كذبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ما كانوا is conjoined to كذبوا; and مؤمنين is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وإلى ثمود أخاهم صالحا﴾: the و is a conjunction; إلى ثمود is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb conjoined to أرسلنا; أخاهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أرسلنا; and صالحا is a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) from ﴿أخاهم﴾.
﴿قال يا قوم اعبدوا الله﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person ياء, which is omitted as indicated by the kasra; and the clause of vocative and command is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما لكم من إله غيره﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; إله is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) in position; and غيره is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إله﴾ according to its position.
﴿قد جاءتكم بينة من ربكم﴾: the clause is included in the object of his saying; جاءتكم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بينة is the fāʿil (agent); and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءتكم, or to an omitted naʿt of بيّنة.
﴿هذه ناقة الله لكم آية﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ. ناقة is the khabar, and the Word of Majesty (Allah) is the muḍāf ilayhi. لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿آية﴾. آية is a ḥāl, and what governs it is the verbal sense indicated by the demonstrative. The clause ﴿هذه ناقة الله﴾ is in the position of nominative as a badal from ﴿بيِّنة﴾, because it serves as its explanation.
﴿فذروها تأكل في أرض الله﴾: the ف is consequential (tafrīʿiyya), because it comes as a consequence of her being one of the signs of Allah, which necessitates not touching her with harm; ذروها is an imperative verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; تأكل is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request; and في أرض الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكل, or to His saying فذروها, on the basis that it is a case of contention (tanāzuʿ, two governors competing for one word).
