﴿ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب أليم﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسوها is an imperfect verb in the jussive, the و is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; بسوء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمسوها; ﴿فيأخذكم﴾: the ف is for causality (sababiyya), and يأخذكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the ف, because it is the answer to the prohibition; the كاف is a mafʿūl bihi; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e.: "Let there be no touching of her on your part, and (so no) seizing of you by a punishment"; عذاب is the fāʿil, and أليم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد عاد﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "and remember the time when He made you"; the clause ﴿جعلكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the كاف is the first mafʿūl bihi of جعلكم, and خلفاء is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿خلفاء﴾; and ﴿عاد﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وبوأكم في الأرض تتخذون من سهولها قصورا﴾: بوأكم is a verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بوأكم; the clause تتخذون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object; من سهولها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تتخذون, or to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿قصورًا﴾; and قصورًا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتنحتون الجبال بيوتا﴾: the و is a conjunction; تنحتون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; الجبال is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "from the mountains"; and بيوتا is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara).
﴿فاذكروا آلاء الله ولا تعثوا في الأرض مفسدين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اذكروا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil; آلاء الله is a mafʿūl bihi; the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تعثوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعثوا; and مفسدين is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿قال الملأ الذين استكبروا من قومه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قال الملأ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الذين is a relative noun in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective); the clause استكبروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and من قومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿للذين استضعفوا لمن آمن منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال; the clause استضعفوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted (element that is a) badal (substitute) from الذين استضعفوا; and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أتعلمون أن صالحا مرسل من ربه﴾: the hamza is for mocking interrogation, and the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); أن is an abrogating particle, صالحا is its noun (ism), and مرسل is its khabar (predicate); أن, its noun and its khabar stand in the place of the two objects of تعلمون; and من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مرسل.
﴿قالوا إنا بما أرسل به مؤمنون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar ﴿مؤمنون﴾; the clause ﴿أرسل﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; إن and what follows it is a clause in the position of accusative as the object of the saying; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسل.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿قال الذين استكبروا﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb; الذين is a relative noun and the fāʿil (agent); and the clause استكبروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا بالذي آمنتم به كافرون﴾: the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿بالذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) ﴿كافرون﴾; the clause ﴿آمنتم به﴾ is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; إن and what follows it is a clause in the position of accusative as the object of the saying; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنتم.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿فعقروا الناقة وعتوا عن أمر ربهم﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); عقروا الناقة is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عتوا is conjoined to عقروا; and عن أمر ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being arrogant", or "acting on what insolence inspired in them".
﴿وقالوا يا صالح ائتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من المرسلين﴾: conjoined to what preceded; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; يا is a vocative particle, and صالح is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the vocative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ائتنا is an imperative verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ائتنا; the clause تعدنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional, and the omitted apodosis is indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then bring us"; and من المرسلين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿فأخذتهم الرجفة فأصبحوا في دارهم جاثمين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; أخذتهم الرجفة is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); فأصبحوا is conjoined to فأخذتهم, and the و is the noun (ism) of أصبحوا; في دارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاثمين; and جاثمين is the khabar (predicate) of أصبحوا.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿فتولى عنهم وقال يا قوم﴾: the ف is a conjunction for immediate succession (taʿqīb); عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولى; قال is conjoined to فتولى; يا is a vocative particle; and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted first-person ياء.
﴿لقد أبلغتكم رسالة ربي﴾: the لام is (in) the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); أبلغتكم is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and رسالة ربي is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ونصحت لكم ولكن لا تحبون الناصحين﴾: conjoined to أبلغتكم; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصحت; the و is circumstantial; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative (muhmal); لا is negating; and the clause لا تحبون الناصحين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it is a narration of a past state (ḥikāyat ḥāl māḍiya).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿ولوطا إذ قال لقومه﴾: the و conjoins to the stories that preceded; لوطًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: "and remember Lot"; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿لوطًا﴾, i.e.: "and remember the time when he said to his people"; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and لقومه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال.
﴿أتأتون الفاحشة﴾: the hamza is for disapproving, rebuking interrogation; تأتون الفاحشة is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما سبقكم بها من أحد من العالمين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e.: "Do you commit it, being the first to begin it?"; or from the mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "Do you commit it, it being begun (by you), not preceded by others than you?" سبقكم is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبقكم, or to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "no one preceded you accompanied by it", i.e. engaged in it; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; أحد is the fāʿil of سبقكم; and من العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t:
﴿فخلف من بعدهم خلف ورثوا الكتاب﴾: The فاء is a conjunction, and خَلَف is a past verb; من بعدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and خَلْف is the fāʿil (agent). The clause ورثوا الكتاب is an adjective (naʿt) of خلف.
﴿يأخذون عرض هذا الأدنى ويقولون سيغفر لنا﴾: The clause is a second adjective. عرض is the object of يأخذون, هذا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الأدنى is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative.
﴿وإن يأتهم عرض مثله يأخذوه﴾: The واو is circumstantial, i.e. «while their state is that if there comes to them…»; or the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional, يأتهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), عرض is the agent, and مثله is an adjective. يأخذوه is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn.
﴿ألم يؤخذ عليهم ميثاق الكتاب﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī), لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, and يؤخذ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم. عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤخذ, and ميثاق الكتاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿أن لا يقولوا على الله إلا الحق﴾: أن is maṣdarī, and together with what falls within its scope it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) whose position is the nominative as a badal of ميثاق, or the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The clause ﴿لا يقولوا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) of ميثاق الكتاب, because it is in the sense of saying without its letters; ﴿لا﴾ is then prohibitive, and ﴿يقولوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive by ﴿لا﴾. On its being maṣdarī, ﴿لا﴾ is negating and the verb is in the accusative by the maṣdarī أن. ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يقولوا, إلا is a particle of restriction, and الحق is the direct object, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. «the true saying».
﴿ودرسوا ما فيه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and درسوا is a past verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ألم يؤخذ عليهم﴾, as if it were said: «the covenant of the Book was taken from them, and they studied what is in it». ما is the object of درسوا, and فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿والدار الآخرة خير للذين يتقون﴾: The واو is resumptive or circumstantial. الدار is the mubtadaʾ (subject), الآخرة an adjective, and خير the khabar (predicate) of الدار; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير. The clause يتقون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the accusative position as a ḥāl.
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), the فاء is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted, لا is negating, and تعقلون is conjoined to this omitted [verb].

muyesser-irab:170-170.t:
﴿والذين يمسكون بالكتاب وأقاموا الصلاة﴾: The واو is resumptive, and الذين is a relative noun in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ (subject); the khabar (predicate) is His saying ﴿إنا لا نضيع...﴾, and the linking pronoun (rābiṭ) is omitted because the meaning is understood, the implied form being «the reformers among them». Or the واو is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿للذين يتقون﴾ in the previous ayah, in the genitive. يمسكون: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and بالكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يمسكون﴾; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿وأقاموا الصلاة﴾ – a verb, agent and object – is conjoined to the ṣila clause, and the clause ﴿والذين يمسكون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا لا نضيع أجر المصلحين﴾: The clause is the khabar of الذين, or resumptive, with no grammatical position. إنّ is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, لا is negating, and the clause ﴿لا نضيع أجر المصلحين﴾ is the khabar of إنّ; the clause ﴿إنا لا نضيع...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:171-171.t:
﴿وإذ نتقنا الجبل فوقهم كأنه ظلة﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied verb conjoined to what preceded, its implied form being «remember». The clause ﴿نتقنا﴾ is in the genitive position by annexation; نتقنا is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its fāʿil (agent), and الجبل is the direct object. فوقهم is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [element] as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الجبل – and it is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), because it is the state of the raising – or it is attached to نتقنا. The clause كأنه ظلة is also a ḥāl of الجبل, so the ḥāl is multiple; [it consists of] كأنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate).
﴿وظنوا أنه واقع بهم﴾: The clause is in the genitive position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نتقنا, which is in the genitive by annexation; or the واو is circumstantial, with قد implied, and the one the ḥāl describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl) is the mountain; or the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. أنّ and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of ظن; أنّ is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, ﴿واقع﴾ is its khabar, and ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to واقع.
﴿خذوا ما آتيناكم بقوة﴾: The clause خذوا is in the accusative position as the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «and We said to them: take». ما is a relative noun, the direct object; the clause آتيناكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and بقوة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «resolved to bear its hardships».
﴿واذكروا ما فيه لعلكم تتقون﴾: Conjoined to what preceded. لعلكم: [لعل] an abrogating particle, the كاف is its noun, and the clause تتقون is its khabar; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:172-172.t:
﴿وإذ أخذ ربك من بني آدم من ظهورهم ذريتهم﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the accusative position as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «remember». أخذ ربك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and من بني آدم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخذ. من ظهورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun in the genitive position as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from بني آدم, or a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull) with the preposition repeated. ذريتهم is the direct object, and the clause ﴿أخذ ربك﴾ is in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأشهدهم على أنفسهم﴾: A preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشهدهم.
﴿ألست بربكم قالوا بلى﴾: The clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl al-qawl), i.e. «saying», and the clause of saying is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). The همزة is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī), the تاء is the noun of ليس, the باء is a redundant (ṣila) particle, and ربكم is genitive in form and the khabar (predicate) of ليس by position. The clause قالوا is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and بلى is a particle of answer for cancelling the negation and affirming what comes after the negative particle, i.e. the affirmation of lordship.
﴿شهدنا أن تقولوا يوم القيامة إنا كنا عن هذا غافلين﴾: شهدنا is a verb and its agent, and أن with what falls within its scope is in the accusative position as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). يوم القيامة: an adverb attached to تقولوا. The clause of إنّ and what falls within its scope is in the accusative position as the object of the saying; the clause كنا is the khabar of إنّ, غافلين is the khabar of كنا, and عن هذا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غافلين.

muyesser-irab:173-173.t:
﴿أو تقولوا إنما أشرك آباؤنا من قبل وكنا ذرية من بعدهم﴾: أو تقولوا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أن تقولوا, and إنما is [إنّ] restrained and restraining (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause إنما أشرك آباؤنا is in the accusative position as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of ذرية. [Translator's note: so in the source; it is presumably من بعدهم that is the adjective of ذرية, the parsing of من قبل having merged with it.]
﴿أفتهلكنا بما فعل المبطلون﴾: The همزة is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the فاء is a conjunction. تهلكنا is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The باء is a preposition and denotes causation, ما is maṣdarī, and ﴿فعل المبطلون﴾ is a verb and its agent; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is in the genitive by the باء.

muyesser-irab:174-174.t: ﴿وكذلك نفصل الآيات ولعلهم يرجعون﴾: The واو is a conjunction. ﴿كذلك﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the accusative position as an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being «with a detailing like that We detail the signs». ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the genitive position as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the لام is for distance, and the كاف is a particle of address. ﴿نفصل﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن», and ﴿الآيات﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ولعلهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction coordinating with something omitted, its implied form being «that they may reflect on them»; لعل is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause ﴿يرجعون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:175-175.t:
﴿واتل عليهم نبأ الذي آتيناه آياتنا فانسلخ منها﴾: The واو is a conjunction coordinating with what ﴿إذ﴾ is attached to in His saying ﴿وإذ أخذ﴾. اتل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت», and عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اتل﴾. نبأ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الذي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause آتيناه is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and آياتنا is a second direct object. فانسلخ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آتيناه, and منها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انسلخ.
﴿فأتبعه الشيطان فكان من الغاوين﴾: أتبع is a past verb, and الشيطان is the agent. ﴿فكان﴾ is conjoined to أتبعه, its noun is latent, and من الغاوين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:176-176.t:
﴿ولو شئنا لرفعناه بها﴾: The واو is circumstantial, and لو is conditional, non-jussive. شيئًا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). [Translator's note: the source writes «شيئًا» here, a misprint for ﴿شئنا﴾.] The لام is the answer of لو, the clause رفعناه has no grammatical position, and بها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رفعناه.
﴿ولكنه أخلد إلى الأرض واتبع هواه﴾: The واو is a conjunction, لكنّ is an abrogating particle, the هاء is its noun, and the clause أخلد is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ; إلى الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخلد.
﴿فمثله كمثل الكلب إن تحمل عليه يلهث أو تتركه يلهث﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, and مثله is the mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كمثل﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the nominative position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and مَثَل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿الكلب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إن﴾ is conditional, ﴿تحمل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تحمل, and ﴿يلهث﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿تتركه﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), conjoined to the protasis, and ﴿يلهث﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis.
﴿ذلك مثل القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ, and مثل القوم is its khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of القوم; the clause كذبوا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كذبوا.
﴿فاقصص القصص لعلهم يتفكرون﴾: The فاء is the faṣīḥa fāʾ, اقصص is an imperative verb, its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت», and القصص, in the sense of «what is narrated», is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause of hope is in the accusative position as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿اقصص﴾.

muyesser-irab:177-177.t:
﴿ساء مثلا القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: ساء is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو»; مثلا is a tamyīz (specification) of the agent of ساء. The clause ﴿ساء﴾ is a fronted khabar (predicate), and القوم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). Something omitted must be supplied so that the tamyīz, the agent and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) are all one in meaning, the implied form being: «evil as a likeness is the likeness of the people», or «evil are the people of the likeness of the people». الذين is an adjective (naʿt) of القوم, and the clause كذبوا بآياتنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنفسهم كانوا يظلمون﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and أنفسهم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يظلمون; [كانوا] is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, the واو is its noun, and the clause يظلمون is its khabar. What follows the conjunctive واو falls within the ṣila, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كذبوا, in the sense of «those who combined denying the signs and wronging themselves»; or it is cut off from it, in the sense of «they wronged by the denial none but themselves». [Translator's note: the word كانوا is missing before «an incomplete, abrogating past verb» in the source.]

muyesser-irab:178-178.t:
﴿من يهد الله فهو المهتدي﴾: من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the accusative position as the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يهد, and الله is its fāʿil (agent). The فاء connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and المهتدي its khabar (predicate).
﴿ومن يضلل﴾: Conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause.
﴿فأولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: The فاء is in the apodosis. أولئك is a demonstrative in the nominative position as the mubtadaʾ, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) for emphasis, with no grammatical position, and الخاسرون is the khabar, in the nominative with the واو. The conditional clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the preceding one.

muyesser-irab:179-179.t:
﴿ولقد ذرأنا لجهنم كثيرا من الجن والإنس﴾: The واو is a conjunction, and the لام is the answer to the omitted oath. ذرأنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), لجهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذرأنا, كثيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and من الجن والإنس is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾.
﴿لهم قلوب لا يفقهون بها ولهم أعين لا يبصرون بها ولهم آذان لا يسمعون بها﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and قلوب is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾, even though it is indefinite, because it is specified by the adjective. The clause لا يفقهون is an adjective of قلوب. The like of that is said of the two following clauses.
﴿أولئك كالأنعام بل هم أضل أولئك هم الغافلون﴾: أولئك is the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كالأنعام﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning «like», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the nominative position as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and الأنعام is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction, هم is a mubtadaʾ, and أضل the khabar. أولئك is a mubtadaʾ, هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك; or ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, الغافلون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause هم الغافلون is the khabar of أولئك.
